August[]

  • August 24: Nazca Railway Central Line Admin Station completed construction.
  • August 27: Nazca Railway Central Line City Hall Station began operations. Central Line is established.
  • August 30: Nazca Railway Central Line, Skyoar Line TriSwamp Station began operations.

September[]

  • September 3: Nazca Railway Skyoar Line Nut Pond Station began operations. Skyoar Line is established.
  • September 10: Nazca Railway Skyoar Line Skyline Station began operations.

October[]

  • October 8:
    • Nazca Railway Skyoar Line, Origin Line Mark 4 Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway Origin Line Sky Castle Station began operations. Origin Line is established.
    • Nazca Railway Origin Line Origin Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway Origin Line 3Pier Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway Origin Line Semilunar Coast Station began operations.
  • October 10: Nazca Railway Origin Line Semilunar Tip Station began operations.

November[]

  • November 2: Nazca Railway Central Line, Skyoar Line White Mesa Station began operations.
  • November 6: Nazca Railway Skyoar Line Sandviched Snow Station began operations.

December[]

  • December 6: Nazca Railway Skyoar Line, Islands Line, Islands Express, Edward Line, Eternal Line, Hartasy Line, High Speed Railway Terracept Terminal began operations, Terracept Division is officially named.
  • December 7: Nazca Railway Origin Line Tai Nga Bay Station began operations, Origin Line began stopping at that Station.

List of Historical Events[]

January[]

  • January 10: Nazca Railway Central Line, Islands Line Wathill Station began operations. Islands Line is established.
  • January 13: Nazca Railway Origin Line North Village Station began operations.
  • January 18:
    • Nazca Railway Islands Line Sandhour Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway Islands Line Green Island Station began operations.

February[]

  • February 12: Nazca Railway Central Line Watorest Station began operations.
  • February 18: Nazca Railway Central Line Watesert Station began operations.
  • February 20: Nazca Railway Islands Line Chisan Station began operations.
  • February 21: Nazca Railway Islands Line Grass Island Station began operations.
  • February 24:
    • Nazca Railway Intra-area Railway Line 301 Whitom Station began operations. Line 301 is established.
    • Nazca Railway Intra-area Railway Line 301 Snowhill Station began operations.

March[]

  • March 10: Nazca Railway Skyoar Line Mark 4 East Station began operations, Skyoar Line began stopping at that Station.

April[]

  • April 22: Nazca Railway Origin Line, Islands Line Youngland Station began operations.

May[]

  • May 18: Nazca Railway Origin Line SAMCITY Station began operations.

  • May 22: Nazca Railway Origin Line Internal Lake Station began operations.
  • May 23: Nazca Railway Islands Line Athena Harbour Station began operations.

  • May 27: Nazca Railway Islands Line Blu Frost Station began operations, Islands Line began stopping at that Station.
  • May 28: Nazca Railway Central Line, Edward Line Carboflame Station began operations, Central Line began stopping at that station, but as Edward Line have yet to begin development, Edward Line did not begin operations.
  • May 29: Nazca Railway Skyoar Line, Grand Ruin Line Grand Ruin Station began operations, but as Grand Ruin Line have yet to begin development, Grand Ruin Line did not begin operations.

June[]

  • June 2: Nazca Railway Islands Line, Grand Ruin Line Imperial Ruin Station began operations, but as Grand Ruin Line have yet to begin development, Grand Ruin Line did not begin operations.
  • June 4: Nazca Railway Islands Line South Ruin Station began operations.
  • June 8: Nazca Railway Grand Ruin Line Main Ruin Station began operations. Grand Ruin Line is established.
  • June 10: Nazca Railway Intra-area Railway Line 301, Line 407 Internal Lake Village Station began operations. Line 407 is established.
  • June 25:
    • Nazca Railway Edward Line Silva Temple Station began operations. Edward Line is established.
    • Nazca Railway Edward Line Axis Island Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway Edward Line extends to Tai Nga Bay Station.
    • Nazca Railway Edward Line Tai Nga Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway Edward Line Tai Nga Hill Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway Edward Line, Eternal Line Caca Hill Station began operations, but as Eternal Line have yet to begin development, Eternal Line did not begin operations.

July[]

  • July 5: Nazca Railway Edward Line, Wardring Line Edward Hill Station began operations, but as Wardring Line have yet to begin development, Wardring Line did not begin operations.
  • July 18: Nazca Railway completed system upgrades.
  • July 21: Nazca Railway Central Line Watiple Station began operations.
  • July 23: Nazca Railway Central Line Quin Biome Station began operations.
  • July 25: Nazca Railway Central Line East Surrest Station began operations.

August[]

  • August 7:

    • Nazca Railway Eternal Line Swamp South Station began operations.
  • August 15:
    • Nazca Railway Eternal Line Bear Trapp Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway Eternal Line Capillaris Station began operations.
  • August 20:
    • Nazca Railway Eternal Line Twin Lava Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway Eternal Line Han River Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway Central Line East Surrest Station became an Eternal Line station.
    • Nazca Railway Eternal Line extends to Quin Biome Station.

September[]

  • September 5:
    • Nazca Railway Hartasy Line Snowa Island Station began operations. Hartasy Line is established.
    • Nazca Railway Hartasy Line, Intra-area Railway Line 311 Tichim Station began operations. Line 311 is established.
    • Nazca Railway Hartasy Line Well Come Cliff Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway Hartasy Line extends to Watesert Station.
    • Nazca Railway Hartasy Line Watombine Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway Hartasy Line Surrest Station began operations.
  • September 9: Nazca Railway Intra-area Railway Line 407 Shadow City Station began operations.
  • September 15: Nazca Railway Intra-area Railway Line 301 Caca Sand Station began operations.
  • September 19: Nazca Railway Skyoar Line Maul Snow Station began operations.
  • September 20: Nazca Railway Skyoar Line Snowless Valley Station began operations.

October[]

  • October 16: Nazca Railway Skyoar Line, Coast Line, Southern Line, High Speed Railway Austrumcept Terminal began operations.
  • October 18: Nazca Railway Edward Line Cliff Shore Station began operations.
  • October 19: Nazca Railway Edward Line Oblique Pool Station began operations.
  • October 20: Nazca Railway Edward Line Ten Tree Mound Station began operations.
  • October 23: Nazca Railway Edward Line Hill Lake Station began operations.
  • October 27: Nazca Railway Edward Line Sandviched Sand Station began operations.
  • October 29: Nazca Railway Edward Line Grasslander Station began operations.
  • October 30: Nazca Railway Edward Line, Continent Line Hammer Forest Station began operations, but as Continent Line have yet to begin development, Continent Line did not begin operations.

November[]

  • November 3: Nazca Railway Edward Line Llama Plains Station began operations.
  • November 5: Nazca Railway Edward Line Philip Pine Station began operations.
  • November 6: Nazca Railway Edward Line Bend Coast Station began operations.
  • November 10: Nazca Railway Intra-area Railway Line 205 Silunar City South Station began operations. Line 205 is established.
  • November 11: Nazca Railway Intra-area Railway Line 205 New Silunar City Station began operations.
  • November 12: Nazca Railway Intra-area Railway Line 205 Central Plains Station began operations.
  • November 13:
    • Nazca Railway Intra-area Railway Line 205 Land Trap Village Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway Intra-area Railway Line 205 Semilunar Forest Station began operations.
  • November 14: Nazca Railway Intra-area Railway Line 205, Line 501 Omni Forest Station began operations. Line 501 is established.
  • November 20: Nazca Railway Islands Line Cyan Path Station began operations.
  • November 26: Nazca Railway Islands Line Circmarsh Station began operations.
  • November 28: Nazca Railway Islands Line, Southern Line Sink Scat Reef Station began operations, but as Southern Line have yet to begin development, Southern Line did not begin operations.

December[]

  • December 1: Nazca Railway Islands Line, Coast Line Three Sym Station began operations, but as Coast Line have yet to begin development, Coast Line did not begin operations.
  • December 4: Nazca Railway Islands Line, Coast Line InGun Taiga Station began operations. Coast Line is established.
  • December 13: Nazca Railway Eternal Line Galaxy Station began operations.
  • December 19: Nazca Railway Eternal Line Tear Station began operations.
  • December 23: Nazca Railway Eternal Line Loxogo Village Station began operations.
  • December 24: Nazca Railway Eternal Line Loxogo Forest Station began operations.
  • December 27: Nazca Railway Eternal Line, Coast Line Sandstone Shoal Station began operations, but as Coast Line have yet to reach Sandstone Shoal Station, Coast Line did not begin operations to that station.
  • December 31:
    • Nazca Railway Intra-area Railway Line 103 TriSwamp Airport Station began operations. Line 103 is established.
    • Nazca Railway Intra-area Railway Line 103 Swamp Ferry Pier Station began operations.

2015 is the year in which Los Sengas was established. This year also marked initial development of Los Sengas and the termination of development of the Terracept Division.

Unless otherwise specified, all events that are described below took place in Los Sengas.

2016 is the second year since Los Sengas was created, and Los Sengas was in mid-development then.

Unless otherwise specified, all events that are described below took place in Los Sengas.
Before May 1 2017, Peckern Transit was named Kasukano Train Railway (KTR). However, for the sake of convenience, all stations built at the KTR-era would be considered Peckern Transit Stations.

《2014 2015 2016 2017 2018》

    • 1.2 February

List of Historical Events[]

January[]

  • January 1:
    • Nazca Railway Flask Line East Margin Station began operations.
    • Project Nazca established a new Facebook Group.
  • January 4:
    • Nazca Railway Luxter Line, Ingress Line Ingress South Station began operations.
    • Los Sengas Division Season 1 Development complete.
  • January 7: Nazca Ferry established HAMGOSASHI LRT.
  • January 9: Nazca Ferry Anshield Island Pier began operations.
  • January 11: Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division Season 2 Development commences.
  • January 12: Route 5 began preparations. Hatace Ferry is established.
  • January 13: Nazca Ferry Duck Island Pier began operations.
  • January 15: Land to the west of Vayler Station began tender process. At the same day, Nazca Ferry Bell Island and Pan-Ward Piers began operations.
  • January 17: Metropolis Terminal Phase III opened to the public.
  • January 23:
    • Nazca Railway West Ring Line Greenrock Hill Station finished upgrading works. It is also the first station to finish upgrading.
    • SLT Golden Origin Stop, Edward Park Lane Stop completed construction.
  • January 26: Nazca Railway Metropolis Terminal finished upgrading works.
  • January 28:
    • Nazca Railway West Ring Line High Approach Station finished upgrading works.
    • The land to the west of Vayler Station has a tender winner.
  • January 30: Nazca Railway West Ring Line Pisces Pond Station finished upgrading works.
  • January 31:
    • Route 5 completed construction.
    • Nazca Ferry Axhead Island Pier began operations.

February[]

  • February 2: Nazca Ferry Beam Island Pier finished upgrading works.
  • February 6: Nazca Railway West Ring Line, Luxter Line Sava Canyon Station finished upgrading works.
  • February 11: Terminal Park installed an Islands teleportation spawn.
  • February 13: World Gazette and Mark 4 (Los Sengas) are established.
  • February 14: Nazca Railway West Ring Line, Luxter Line West Shoal Station finished upgrading works.
  • February 16: Los Sengas Police and Los Sengas Fire Station are established.
  • February 24: Nazca Railway Luxter Line Downwell Sand Station finished upgrading works. Brain Island completed geographical works.

March[]

  • March 2: Nazca Railway New Edward Line, Stadium Line Red Stadium Station finished upgrading works.
  • March 4: Nazca Railway Stadium Line Bonyal Estate Station finished upgrading works.
  • March 6: HAMGOSASHI Conglomerate is established.
  • March 8: Nazca Railway New Edward Line Seat River Station finished upgrading works. At the same day, the land to the west of Vayler Station was reclaimed by the Government.
  • March 10: Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals Incident Bay Terminal completed upgrading works.
  • March 21: Nazca Railway Stadium Line Flask East Station finished upgrading works.
  • March 21: Los Sengas Permanent Corporations Policy has been modified. No new companies with the name "Nazca" or "Los Sengas" can be estaablished. All companies ran by administrators are also publicized.
  • March 24: The first section of Route 5 Seat River JT completed construction. The Hatace Island Exit of Route 5 also completed construction. Deepond Island began development.
  • March 25: Nazca Railway Stadium Line, Echo Line Kong Corner Station began operations.
  • March 27: Nazca Railway Stadium Line Raytree Station began operations.
  • March 29: Nazca Railway Stadium Line, Echo Line Prosand Station began operations. Echo Line is established.

  • April 2: Nazca Railway West Ring Line Droplet Island Station finished upgrading works.
  • April 4: Nazca Railway West Ring Line Axhead Island Station and West Ring Line, Arcgo Line Fansim Island Station finished upgrading works. At the same day, Star Island Light Rail Phase I completed construction.

  • April 17: Nazca Railway Arcgo Line Fosina Station began operations.
  • April 18: The first Horse Spawning Station is established.

  • April 23: The second Deepond Island Devleopment Report is released.
  • April 24: Nazca Railway Arcgo Line Internal River Station began operations.
  • April 26: Nazca Railway Arcgo Line Metro River Station finished upgrading works.

  • May 1: Nazca Ferry abandoned plans to build a pier on Brain Island.
  • May 3: Nazca Railway Alpha Line Zootuary Station began operations. Alpha Line is established.
  • May 4: Nazca Railway East Ring Line, Urban Line High Mesa Station finished upgrading works.
  • May 5: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Metro Spring Station finished upgrading works.
  • May 6: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Cyan Loop Station finished upgrading works.
  • May 9: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Pier Cliff Station and Kaling Channel Station finished upgrading works.
  • May 12: Nazca Railway Alpha Line tracks between Metropolis Terminal and Katadelphia North Checkpoint are connected.
  • May 13: Nazca Railway Arcgo Line Vayler Station finished upgrading works.
  • May 15:
    • World Gazette Issue 1 was released.[1].
    • Los Sengas Government is officially established.
  • May 16:
    • Route 5 Milead Pond exit completed construction. Mayler Airport began expansion.
    • Nazca Railway Arcgo Line Mayler Airport Station is abolished.
    • Nazca Railway Delta Line is established.
  • May 21:
    • Nazca Railway Stadium Line New Judy Island Station（Now named Bulldoze Island Station）finished upgrading works.
    • Nazca Ferry applied for the land to the west of the Pier on Belt Island.

  • May 29: Nazca Ferry Deepond Island Pier began operations.

    • West Metropolis Archipelago suspended Highly Permitted Island Development applications.
    • Shops are added at Nazca Railway West Ring Line Gull Woods Station.

    • Nazca Railway West Ring Line, Stadium Line Peckern Forest Station finished upgrading works.

  • June 11: Nazca Railway Stadium Line, Daring Line Proyga Station finished upgrading works.

  • June 13: The second section of Route 4 and Route 5 Seat River JT completed construction.

    • Anshield Island Light Rail Anmiddle Residental Area Station began operations.
  • June 22: Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals Metrojoint Terminal began operations.
  • June 24: Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals TriPaw Terminal began operations. Metro-Vector-Paw Container Terminals completed construction.
  • June 25:
    • Nazca Railway New Edward Line Boundary Island Station began operations.

  • June 27: Anshield Island Light Rail Hoi Tun Beach Station began operations.
  • June 29: Nazca Railway Urban Line TriPaw Station began operations.

July[]

  • July 1: Nazca Railway Delta Line Belt Island Station began operations.
  • July 2: Nazca Railway Delta Line Purple Gate Station began operations.
  • July 5: Nazca Railway North Mountain Station completed Platform expansion of the Sava Line section.
  • July 6: The fourth Deepond Island Devleopment Report is released.
  • July 7: Nazca Ferry Yashi Island Pier began operations.
  • July 8:
    • Nazca Railway Sava Line Hillum Station began operations. Sava Line is established.
    • World Gazette Issue 5 was released [4].
  • July 10: Nazca Railway Sava Line Lake Lane Station began operations.
  • July 13:
    • Nazca Railway Sava Line Brackox Station began operations.
    • Brain Island Street Terminus began operations.
  • July 14: Nazca Railway Sava Line Venus Street Station began operations.
  • July 15: The Nazca Ferry between Sanfo Island and Beam Island was cancelled.
  • July 16: Nazca Railway The Three Pass Station completed expansion.
  • July 18:
    • Nazca Railway Sava Line Sayler Depot began operations.
    • Kong Corner Road, Splended River Road began operations.
  • July 19: Nazca Railway Sava Line Sand-O Bay Station began operations.
  • July 23: Nazca Railway Sava Line Southend Station began operations.
  • July 24: World Gazette Issue 6 was released[5].
  • July 25: Nazca Railway Sava Line Savanna Central Station began operations. Sava Line completed construction, and the Sava Line Opening Ceremory took place.
  • July 27: Nazca Railway West Ring Line Milead Pond Station finished upgrading works.
  • July 29: Nazca Railway West Ring Line Wood Wound Station finished upgrading works.
  • July 31: New Judy Island Monorail East New Judy Station completed construction.

August[]

  • August 1:

  • August 4:

  • August 9: Project Nazca Hunger Games was held [7].
  • August 10: Nazca Railway West Ring Line Jessica Island Station finished upgrading works.
  • August 11: Nazca Railway West Ring Line Inception Bay Station finished upgrading works.

  • August 15: Nazca Railway West Ring Line Sheung Che Nung Station finished upgrading works.

  • August 21: Nazca Railway West Ring Line Pisces Pond Station Exit Banner finished updating.
  • August 22: Sava Power Plant began operations.
  • August 23: Nazca Railway West Ring Line Pan-ward Station finished upgrading works.
  • August 24: Nazca Railway West Ring Line Comic Ward Station finished upgrading works.
  • August 25: Nazca Railway West Ring Line Night Curve Station, Tai Nung Plains Station finished upgrading works.
  • August 27: Nazca Railway West Ring Line Metro Stone Station began operations. At the time it was the second station with only one platform after Boundary Island Station.

  • August 31: Nazca Railway Kinight Line Ani Ward Station finished upgrading works.

September[]

  • September 2: Nazca Railway New Edward Line Lean Forest Station finished upgrading works.

  • September 8: Nazca Railway New Edward Line, Kinight Line, Bravo Line Edward Island Station finished upgrading works.

  • September 14:

  • September 16:

  • September 27: Phase One of Los Sengas NR Station Upgrade Scheme is complete.
  • September 29: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Dul-las Station began operations.

    • Nazca Railway East Ring Line Vertex Tip Station completed construction.

  • November 11: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Tip East Station completed construction.
  • November 12: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Tip East Station began operations.
  • November 14: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Sharpness Plains Station completed construction.
  • November 15: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Sharpness Plains Station began operations.
  • November 17: Nazca Railway fifth anniversary.
  • November 18: Nazca Railway East Ring Line, Flask Line Lower Oasis Station completed construction.
  • November 20: Nazca Railway East Ring Line, Flask Line Lower Oasis Station began operations.
  • November 25: World Gazette Issue 12 was released[11].
  • November 27: New Judy Island Monorail formed a complete ring and completed construction.
  • November 28: Nazca Railway New Edward Line Litchi Pool Station completed construction.
  • November 29: Nazca Railway New Edward Line Litchi Pool Station began operations.

safeHtml:
2017 is the third year since Los Sengas was created, and Los Sengas was in mid-development then.

Unless otherwise specified, all events that are described below took place in Los Sengas.
Before May 1 2017, Peckern Transit was named Kasukano Train Railway (KTR). However, for the sake of convenience, all stations built at the KTR-era would be considered Peckern Transit Stations.

《2015 2016 2017 2018 2019》

Contents

  • 1 List of Historical Events
    • 1.1 January
    • 1.2 February
    • 1.3 March
    • 1.4 April
    • 1.5 May
    • 1.6 June
    • 1.7 July
    • 1.8 August
    • 1.9 September
    • 1.10 October
    • 1.11 November
    • 1.12 December
  • 2 Citations and References

List of Historical Events[]

January[]

  • January 1:
    • Peckern Transit Newmarket Station completed construction.
    • Nazca Ferry Haber Island Pier completed construction.
  • January 3:
    • DCNA Sava Power Plant Street Terminal began operations.
    • Peckern Transit Northland Line began planning, and feasibility studies for the Northen Extension of Northland Line to Eagle Island also began.
  • January 5:
    • Nazca Railway Daring Line, Delta Line Purplaetus Station began operations.
    • World Gazette Issue 13 was released[1].
  • January 6: Peckern Transit Peckern Line, Eastcoast Line Purple Gate Station began planning.
  • January 9: Nazca Railway Flask Line, Oasis Bay Line Cansand Bay Station began operations.
  • January 11: Peckern Transit Northland Line, Eastcoast Line, Metro Line, KTR Light Railway Grand Squirrel Station began planning. (Metro Line was named New Peckern Express at the time.)
  • January 12: Northland Line began planning its Stem Islands Branch Line extension.
  • January 13: Nazca Railway East Ring Line, Oasis Bay Line Wooden Abyss Station began operations. Oasis Bay Line is established.
  • January 14: Peckern Transit Northland Line Stem Islads Branch Line plan modified (Stem Island Station Inserted).
  • January 15: Los Sengas Districts are first defined.
  • January 17:
    • Nazca Railway East Ring Line Adju Pit Station began operations.
    • World Gazette Issue 14 was released[2].
  • January 18: Peckern Transit Peckern Line, Northland Line Chu Ka Wui Station completed construction.
  • January 21:
    • Nazca Railway East Ring Line Heart River Station began operations.
    • Peckern Transit Peckern Line, Northland Line Laikapin Station completed construction.
  • January 22: Peckern Transit Metro Line began planning. (Then named New Peckern Express.)
  • January 23: Nazca Railway Origin Station completed its expansion and added a set of side platforms for Origin Line.
  • January 24: Peckern Transit Peckern Line, Eastcoast Line Fu Shing Station completed construction.
  • January 26:
    • Nazca Railway East Ring Line Backcomma Beach Station began operations.
    • Peckern Transit Peckern Line Rabbit Land Station began operations.
  • January 28: Peckern Transit Peckern Line Woyi Gap Station (Named Kinpriate Place Station at the time) began operations.[3]
  • January 31: West Metropolis Archipelago (N) Island info were officially released, and announcements of islands opening for registration were made.

February[]

  • February 2: Peckern Transit Northland Line West Metropolis Archipelago Extension plans were announced.
  • February 3: Nazca Railway Oasis Bay Line Southern Heights Station began operations.
  • February 5: World Gazette Issue 15 was released[4].
  • February 6: DCNA Southeast Island Street Terminal completed construction.
  • February 7: DCNA Abutment Island Street Terminal completed construction.
  • February 8: DCNA Crane Island Street Terminal completed construction.
  • February 9: DCNA Arcgo North Island Street Terminal completed construction.
  • February 11: Metropolis Terminal Phase IV completed construction for Origin Line, Fox Line, Lima Line (Then ARIES Line) and Metro Line (Then New Peckern Express).
  • February 12: Nazca Railway Origin Line is established.
  • February 13: Peckern Transit Northland Line, Eastern Line Neargull Station completed construction.
  • February 14: DCNA Stack Island, Northtip Island Street Terminal completed construction.
  • February 15:
    • DCNA Obtuse Isle and Dryers Isle Street Terminal completed construction and began operations.
    • Peckern Transit Northland Line Dark Pearl Island Station completed construction.
  • February 18: Peckern Transit Northland Line Eagle Island Station completed construction.
  • February 19: Nazca Railway Flask East Station Bravo Line Platforms completed construction. At the same day, Bravo Line extended from Metropolis Terminal to this Station.
  • February 21: Nazca Railway Expo Line LSWorld-Expo Station completed construction.
  • February 23: Peckern Transit Northland Line Grensis Island Station began operations.
  • February 24: Peckern Transit Northland Line Malluna Isle Station began operations.
  • February 25: Peckern Transit Northland Line Stack Island Station began operations.
  • February 26: Peckern Transit Northland Line Earn Island Station began operations.
  • February 28: Peckern Transit Northland Line Seaside Island Station began operations.

March[]

  • March 4: Nazca Railway Expo Line is established and completed construction.
  • March 5: Peckern Transit Northland Line Decajotine Island Station completed construction.
  • March 7: Peckern Transit Northland Line Mosaic Island Station completed construction.
  • March 10:
    • Nazca Railway Fox Line is established.
    • Peckern Transit Northland Line Southeast Island Station completed construction.
  • March 11: Peckern Transit Northland Line Crane Island Station completed construction.
  • March 12:
    • Peckern Transit Northland Line Stem Island Station, Wholeheart Island Station completed construction.
    • Anshield Island completed development.
  • March 17: Peckern Transit Northland Line Bunpk Isle Station completed construction.
  • March 18:
    • Nazca Railway Xofa Line, Fox Line Silver Plateau Station began operations. (Xofa Line was named Xofa Crescent at the time.)
    • Nazca Railway Xofa Line is established.
    • Splended River Bridge completed expansion and diversion works.
    • Peckern Transit Peckern Line Silver Plateau Station completed construction.
  • March 21: Peckern Transit Northland Line Abutment Island Station completed construction.
  • March 22: Peckern Transit Northland Line Arcgo North Island completed construction.
  • March 24: Peckern Transit Peckern Line, Metro Line New Phantasm Station completed construction.[5]
  • March 25:
    • Nazca Railway Origin Line, Fox Line Flask North Station began operations. At the same day, Origin Line and Fox Line extended from Origin Station and Metropolis Terminal respectively to this station.
    • Echo Line merged with Bravo Line. Bravo Line extended to Prosand.
    • Peckern Transit KTR Light Railway plans released.
    • Peckern Transit Peckern Line Central Plains Station completed construction, and the soon-to-be-complete Grand Squirrel Checkpoint upgraded into a Checkpoint.
  • March 26:
    • Peckern Transit Northland Line, Eastern Line, Metro Line, KTR Light Railway Grand Squirrel Checkpoint completed construction.
    • Peckern Transit Peckern Line Tunglo Bay Station completed construction.
  • March 27: Peckern Transit Peckern Line Shiny River Station completed construction.
  • March 28:
    • Nazca Railway Edward Island Station upgraded into a Checkpoint for Interisland Line establishment.
    • World Gazette license expires.
  • March 29: Peckern Transit Northland Line Shoalsouth Station, Shoalsouth Depot completed construction.

April[]

  • April 1: Peckern Transit Northland Line Threetea Station completed construction.
  • April 2:
    • Nazca Railway Info Island Station completed expansion.
    • Peckern Transit Northland Line Smoke Stage Station completed construction.
  • April 3: Peckern Transit Northland Line Sakura Shita Station completed construction.
  • April 4: Nazca Railway Interisland Line Fire Two Island Station began operations. Interisland Line is established.
  • April 5:
    • Peckern Transit Northland Line Treeless hill Station completed construction.
    • Peckern Transit Northland Line completed construction.
  • April 8:
    • The rest of the Peckern Transit Peckern Line Stations (Silver Plateau Station, New Phantasm Station, Central Plains Station, Tunglo Bay Station, Shiny River Station, Shiny River Depot) began operations.
    • Peckern Transit Metro Line New Phantasm Station---Grand Squirrel Checkpoint began operations.
    • Peckern Transit Southern Loop began construction.
  • April 11: Peckern Transit Metro Line Grand Squirrel Checkpoint---Metropolis Terminal began operations.
  • April 13: Nazca Railway Luxter Line, Ingress Line Ingress Diamond Station began operations. Ingress Line is established.
  • April 22: Project Nazca Server upgraded to Minecraft Version 1.11.2.
  • April 28: Nazca Railway East Ring Line, Ingress Line Coldland Bay Station began operations, but Under Hill Station has not been built yet, so Ingress Line has yet to extend to Coldland Bay.

May[]

  • May 1: Kasukano Train Railway was renamed Peckern Metro (Subsequently renamed Peckern Transit) after all the original developers left Los Sengas due to historical reasons.Peckern Metro suspended all operations.
  • May 5: Nazca Railway East Ring Line, Ingress Line Under Hill Station began operations, Ingress Line extends to Coldland Bay.
  • May 6: Peckern Metro resumed operations.
  • May 10: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Comrel Island Station began operations, and caused East Ring Line to have the first Island Station.
  • May 17: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Perquel Island Station began operations.
  • May 24: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Squirrel Tail Station began operations. Moreover, this station, along with Perquel Island Station, is the second instance of Nazca Railway having two stations on a single island after Airship Island Station and Airship Deck Station.
  • May 31: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Outcave Station began operations.

June[]

  • June 8: Nazca Railway Interisland Line Bell Island Station began operations.
  • June 10: Nazca Railway Belt Island Station completed Platform expansion of the Interisland Line Section. At the same day, Interisland Line extends to Belt Island Station.
  • June 13: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Visitor's Ground Station began operations.
  • June 17: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Johnson Views Station began operations, and caused East Ring Line to have all six existing station types at the time (Aboveground, Ground, Underground, Island, Pseudoground, Plateau).
  • June 21: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Kelper Mount Station began operations.
  • June 26: Nazca Railway East Ring Line, New Edward Line Newmonth River Station began operations, but as Litchi Pool Station has not yet been built, New Edward Line did not extend to Newmonth River.
  • June 30: Nazca Railway East Ring Line, New Edward Line Hourglass Bay Station begun operations, but as Litchi Pool Station has not yet been built, New Edward Line did not extend to Hourglass Bay.

July[]

  • July 1: Nazca Railway Red Stadium Station and Seat River Station completed updating New Edward Line signage.
  • July 2: Nazca Railway New Edward Line Litchi Lake Station began operations, New Edward Line extends to Hourglass Bay Station.
  • July 7: Lines in Phase 1 of Co-Op Railway are announced.
  • July 9: Great City Railway Bonyal to Cyan Loop Line began operations.
  • July 10: Toshin Kyuko Dentetsu Downtown Loop Line completed loop, Metro Stone branch began operations.
  • July 12: Nazca Railway Deepond Island StationInterisland Line completed Platform expansion of the Interisland Line Section.
  • July 15: Nazca Railway Interisland Line Elevate Island Station began operations, Interisland Line extends to Deepond Island Station. With that, the south section of West Ring Line, New Edward Line, Stadium Line, Arcgo Line, Bravo Line and Delta Line can interchange through Kinight Line and Interisland Line.
  • July 19: Nazca Railway East Ring Line , Egress Line Rapid Rivulet Station began operations.
  • July 21: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Quarter Basin Station began operations.
  • July 24: Nazca Railway East Ring Line , Egress Line Parallel Bay Station began operations, Egress Line is established.

August[]

  • August 1:
    • Project Nazca fifth anniversary.
    • Nazca Railway announced that all platform and exit signs would be of ImageOnMap Signs starting from Icelute Island Station.
    • Lines in Phase 2 of Co-Op Railway are announced.
  • August 2: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Icelute Island Station began operations. This is also the first station to be built using new ImageOnMap Signs.
  • August 3: Metro Railway Leanpool Line Bonyal Peninsula Station completed construction.
  • August 5: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Flamelute Island Station began operations.
  • August 9: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Yowah North Station began operations.
  • August 11: Nazca Railway Egress Line River Rendezvous Station began operations.
  • August 15: Metro Railway Leanpool Line Lean Forest Station began operations. Leanpool Line is established.
  • August 17:
    • Nazca Railway services reached Cometsilk.
    • Metro Railway Leanpool Line Lean Forest North Station began operations.
  • August 19: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Warm Cairn Station began operations.
  • August 21: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Comet Terrace Station began operations.
  • August 22: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Spinstone Plane Station began operations.
  • August 23: Metro Railway Leanpool Line Numpool West Station began operations.
  • August 25: Nawis Railway Peckern Main Line Landing Pole Station completed construction.
  • August 26: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Weaving Plate Station began operations.
  • August 27: Metro Railway Leanpool Line Numpool Station began operations. Metro Railway Leanpool Line Phase I copmlete.

September[]

  • September 4:
    • Nazca Railway East Ring Line Silk Pond Vista Station began operations.
    • Nawis Railway Peckern Main Line Bay North Station began operations. Peckern Main Line is established.
  • September 6: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Silk Pond Station began operations, Silk Pond Bridge is connected.
  • September 9: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Gentle Island Station began operations.
  • September 11: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Harvest River Station began operations.
  • September 16: Nazca Railway East Ring Line, Stadium Line, Bravo Line Virtel Heights Station began operations. Stadium Line and Bravo Line platforms have yet to enter service.
  • September 19: Nazca Railway services reached Torrent.
  • September 21: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Torrent South Station began operations.
  • September 22: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Dune Ocean Station began operations.
  • September 23: Nawis Railway Peckern Main Line extends to Senriyama Station.
  • September 24: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Dawn Hill Station began operations.
  • September 25: Fong Wah Tunnel began operations[6].
  • September 26: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Abunest East Station began operations.
  • September 27: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Abunest West Station began operations.
  • September 28: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Xylog Gate Station began operations, East Ring Line formed a complete ring and completed construction.

October[]

  • October 1: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Ring Completion Ceremony was held at Outcave Station.
  • October 15: Nawis Railway Peckern Main Line Wui Hop Station began operations.
  • October 17: Nawis Railway Peckern Main Line Wui King Station began operations.
  • October 19: Nawis Railway Peckern Main Line Wuiking Pond Station began operations.
  • October 21: Nawis Railway Peckern Main Line Black Forest Station and Polywood Station began operations.
  • October 22: Nawis Railway Peckern Main Line Intus Occident Station began operations.
  • October 23: Nawis Railway Peckern Main Line West Plateau Station began operations.
  • October 27: Nazca Railway Stadium Line Calmé Station began operations.

November[]

  • November 3: Nazca Railway Stadium Line, Bravo Line, Kilo Line Pi Lake Station began operations, Kilo Line Platforms have yet to enter service.
  • November 9: Nazca Railway Stadium Line Silk Pond North Station began operations.
  • November 17:
    • Nazca Railway Stadium Line Purity Corner Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway Heaven Pacific Division Forward Line Heaven Pacific Station completed construction.
  • November 23: Nazca Railway Stadium Line Spade Valley Station and Stadium Line, Bravo Line Spade Valley Stabling Sidings began operations. At the same day Stadium Line and Bravo Line extends to Virtel Heights Station.
  • November 28: Nazca Railway changed all Stadium Line eastbound signage.
  • November 29: Nazca Railway Stadium Line, Bravo Line Intus Orient Gateway began operations, and is the 200th station of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division, as well as the second Gateway. This station also held the record to have a Veloduct stopping at two consecutive Standard Railway Stations.

December[]

  • December 3: Nazca Railway Heaven Pacific Division Forward Line Blazrag Bay Station began operations. Forward Line is established.
  • December 9: Nazca Railway Heaven Pacific Division Forward Line Loopturn Station began operations.
  • December 15: Lines in Phase 3 of Co-Op Railway are announced.
  • December 16: Nazca Railway Heaven Pacific Division Forward Line Semilunar Lake Station began operations.
  • December 21:
    • Nazca Railway Heaven Pacific Division Forward Line Hillside Station began operations.
    • Metro Railway Leanpool Line Kaling Channel Station began operations.
  • December 24:
    • Toshin Kyuko Dentetsu Tokaido Line began operations, and held the completion ceremony alongside Nawis Railway Peckern Main Line.
    • Metro Railway Leanpool Line Kaling Sea East Station began operations.
  • December 27: Nazca Railway Heaven Pacific Division Forward Line Colander Pond Station began operations.
  • December 29: Metro Railway Leanpool Line Aest Station began operations. Metro Railway Leanpool Line Phase II copmlete.
  • December 30: Nazca Railway Heaven Pacific Division Forward Line White Market Station began operations.

2018 is the forth year since Los Sengas was created.

Unless otherwise specified, all events that are described below took place in Los Sengas.

《2016 2017 2018 2019 2020》

Contents

List of Historical Events[]

January[]

  • January 3: Nazca Railway Droplet Island Station completed expansion of the Interisland Line section.
  • January 6: Nazca Railway Interisland Line Coubird Island Station began operations.
  • January 11: Nazca Railway Kinight Line, Bravo Line Zerda Hill Station began operations.
  • January 14: Nazca Railway Bravo Line ceased services at Prosand Station.
  • January 20: Nazca Railway Bravo Line, Fox Line began connecting services.
  • January 23: Nazca Railway Kelper Mount Station completed expansion of the Delta Line section.
  • January 27:
    • Nazca Railway Abyss Line, Delta Line Dusty Station began operations.
    • Delta Line extends to Kelper Mount Station.

February[]

  • February 3: Nazca Railway New Edward Line, Cometsilk Line, Delta Line, Kilo Line Nail Bight Checkpoint began operations, New Edward Line and Delta Line extended from Hourglass Bay Station and Kelper Mount Station respectively to that station.
  • February 15: Nazca Railway Comet Terrace Station completed expansion of the Cometsilk Line section.Cometsilk Line is established.
  • February 19: Nazca Railway Spinstone Plane Station completed platform expansion of the Kilo Line section.Kilo Line is established.
  • February 20: Nazca Railway Kilo Line extends to Pi Lake Station.

March[]

  • March 3 : Nazca Railway Ingress Line, Charlie Line Chilly Canyon Station began operations.
  • March 17: Nazca Railway Interisland Line Eclipse Island Station began operations.
  • March 21: Nazca Railway Interisland Line Northtip Island Station began operations.
  • March 22: Lines in Phase 4 of Co-Op Railway are announced.
  • March 24: Nazca Railway Kong Corner Station completed expansion of the Abyss Line section and changed station signage.
  • March 27: Nazca Railway Justin Station completed expansion of the Abyss Line section and changed station signage.
  • March 30: Nazca Railway Heart River Station completed expansion of the Abyss Line section and changed station signage.
  • March 31:
    • Nawis Railway Southern Corridor Wong E-Tech Station completed construction.
    • Nawis Railway Southern Corridor Zerda Hill Station began operations. Southern Corridor is established.

April[]

  • April 1:
    • Nazca Railway Terracept Division temporarily re-opened.
    • Chinese Express Yowah Line Kong On Street Station began operations.
    • Nawis Railway Southern Corridor Comic Ward Station began operations.
  • April 2:
    • Chinese Express Yowah Line Kong Corner Station began operations.
    • Nawis Railway Southern Corridor Sandy Heights Station began operations.
  • April 3:
    • Nazca Railway Abyss Line Upson Opens Station began operations. Abyss Line is established.
    • Chinese Express Yowah Line Yowah Station began operations.
    • Friendly Railways Punctual Line, Silk Pond Line, Kelpro Line, Kelpro Express Kelper Mount Station completed construction.
  • April 4:
    • Chinese Express Yowah Line Prosand Station began operations.
    • Nawis Railway Southern Corridor Tenbal Island Station began operations.
  • April 5: Chinese Express Yowah Line Riverwest Station and Yowah Point Station began operations.
  • April 6: Chinese Express Yowah Line Cyanland Station began operations.
  • April 7:
    • Nazca Railway Abyss Line Blue Swamp Station began operations. At the same day, Abyss Line extends to Justin Station.
    • Chinese Express Yowah Line Fosina Station began operations.
  • April 10: NAR Southern Corridor Phase I began operations.
  • April 11:
    • Downtown Transit Sirius Line, Sirius Express Downwell Sand Station completed construction.
    • Nawis Railway Southern Corridor Shony Island Station began operations.
  • April 17: Nazca Railway Abyss Line Rectime Bay Station began operations.
  • April 18: Downtown Transit Sirius Line Lake Lane Station began operations. Sirius Line is established.
  • April 25: Nazca Railway Abyss Line Compahills Station began operations.
  • April 27: Nazca Railway Abyss Line Oganesson Station began operations. At the same day, Abyss Line extends to Kong Corner Station.

May[]

  • May 20: Nazca Railway Interisland Line Earn Island Station began operations.
  • May 22: Nazca Railway Interisland Line Stack Island Station began operations.
  • May 24: Nazca Railway Interisland Line Wholeheart Island Station began operations.
  • May 26: Nazca Railway Interisland Line Grensis Island Station began operations.
  • May 28:
    • Nazca Railway Interisland Line Platform Isle Station and Finnick Station began operations.
    • Interisland Line completed construction.
    • Los Sengas Division Season 2 Development complete.

June[]

  • June 3: Downtown Transit Sirius Line Centraver Station and Desert Field Station began operations.
  • June 4:
    • Katadelphia Railway, Peckern Metro and Southern Loop became a part of Co-Op Railway and is now subject to Co-Op Railway regulations.
    • Downtown Transit Sirius Line Loop Lake Station began operations.
  • June 9: Downtown Transit Sirius Line, Sirius Express Polibiomes Station began operations. Sirius Express is established.
  • June 18: Friendly Railways Punctual Line Fox River Station began operations. Punctual Line is established.
  • June 19: Friendly Railways Punctual Line Litchi Lake Station began operations.
  • June 21: Friendly Railways Punctual Line Sanlum Village Station began operations.
  • June 24: Friendly Railways Punctual Line, Silk Pond Line Gourd Dune Station began operations.
  • June 25: Friendly Railways Punctual Line Pincers River Station began operations.
  • June 26: Friendly Railways Punctual Line Raytree Station began operations.
  • June 27: Friendly Railways Punctual Line Johnson Plain Station began operations.
  • June 30:
    • Friendly Railways Punctual Line Bulake Forest Station began operations.
    • Downtown Transit Sirius Line Barren Valley Station began operations.

July[]

  • July 2: Friendly Railways Punctual Line Visitor's Ground Station began operations.
  • July 20: Nazca Railway Heaven Pacific Division ended operations.
  • July 30: Downtown Transit Sirius Line Phase I began operations.

August[]

  • August 1: Project Nazca sixth anniversary.
  • August 16: Los Sengas NR Station Upgrade Scheme officially completed.
  • August 19: Nazca Railway Arcgo Line Pingsing Station began operations.
  • August 21: Nazca Railway Arcgo Line Dansein Joint Station began operations.
  • August 23: Nazca Railway Arcgo Line Dansein Market Station began operations.
  • August 25: Cities Transit Peckern City Circular Phase I began operations.
  • August 30: Nazca Railway The Pioneer's Inn began operations.

September[]

  • September 1: Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division Season 3 Development commences.
  • September 5: Metropolis Terminal Phase V completed construction.
  • September 6: Lines in Phase 5 of Co-Op Railway are announced.
  • September 8: Chinese Express Yowah Line Cyan Loop Station began operations.
  • September 9: Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line Compahills Station completed construction.
  • September 10:
    • Nawis Railway Southern Corridor Miner North Station began operations.
    • Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line Pincers River Station began operations. Hook Sand Line is established.
  • September 11: Downtown Transit Sirius Line Tortoises' Bay Station began operations.
  • September 12:
    • Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line Finnick Compass Station began operations.
    • Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line Pashion Corner Station began operations.
  • September 13:
    • Downtown Transit Sirius Line Triverge Station and Chitanda Station began operations.
    • Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line Spinstone End Station began operations.
  • September 14: StarTop Railway Cadence Line Yowah Point Station completed construction.
  • September 15: Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line extends to Prosand Station.
  • September 16:
    • Nawis Railway Southern Corridor Tsin Shui Wu Station began operations.
    • Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line Mangkhut Station began operations.
  • September 17:
    • Nazca Railway Urban Line Longwington Station began operations.
    • Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line Rhombus Sand Station began operations.
  • September 18: Nawis Railway Southern Corridor TriPaw Station began operations.
  • September 19: Nawis Railway Southern Corridor Island Gales Station began operations.
  • September 20: Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line Keth Bay Station began operations.
  • September 21: Nazca Railway Urban Line, Urban Express Intus Aquilo Gateway began operations.
  • September 22:
    • StarTop Railway Cadence Line Soaring Coast Station began operations. Cadence Line is established.
    • Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line Tennessine Surge Station began operations.
  • September 24:
    • Nazca Railway Urban Line Mei Fwong Station began operations.
    • Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line Yowah North Station began operations.
  • September 26: Nawis Railway Southern Corridor Tsurume Station began operations.
  • September 27: Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line Xylog Cliff Station began operations.
  • September 29:
    • Nazca Railway Urban Line, Urban Express Tat Stone Hill Station began operations.
    • Nawis Railway Southern Corridor Old Brightland Station began operations.
    • Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line Melt Point Station began operations.

October[]

  • October 1: Nawis Railway Southern Corridor Chimes Canyon Station began operations.
  • October 3: Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line Unbalanced Bay Station began operations.
  • October 6: Nazca Railway Urban Line Smelting Bay Station began operations.
  • October 7: Downtown Transit Sirius Line Internal Sea East Station began operations.
  • October 11: Downtown Transit Sirius Line Tooth Cliff Station began operations.
  • October 12:
    • The Fox Line section between Wativer Station and Middle Island Station suspended services due to external structures.
    • As Hatace Island Station of Stadium Line has external structures, the Departure Routine and Platform Gates M&E structures are damaged. Hence, the section between Bonyal Estate Station and Beam Island Station suspended services.
  • October 13: Nazca Railway Urban Line, Urban Express Intus Austrum Gateway began operations.
  • October 17:
    • Downtown Transit Sirius Line Terutsuki Station began operations.
    • StarTop Railway Cadence Line Twintip Rivers Station completed construction.
  • October 20: Nazca Railway The Shuttle Sava Link Sava Node began operations.
  • October 28:
    • Nazca Railway Gondola Line Decajotine Island Station began operations. Gondola Line is established.
    • Downtown Transit Sirius Line Shore Tip Station began operations.
  • October 31: Nazca Railway Gondola Line Mosaic Island Station began operations.

November[]

  • November 3: Downtown Transit Sirius Line, Sirius Express Upper Maritime Station began operations.
  • November 6: Nazca Railway Gondola Line Southeast Island Station began operations.
  • November 11: Nazca Railway Stadow Line Abutment Island Station completed construction. However, as Crane Island Station was not yet constructed, Stadow Line was not yet established.
  • November 17: Nazca Railway seventh anniversary.
  • November 19: Nazca Railway Stadow Line, Gondola Line Crane Island Station and Abutment Island Station began operations. This meant that Gondola Line completed construction, and Stadow Line is established.
  • November 25: Nazca Railway Stadow Line Sunrise Island Station completed construction.
  • November 30: Nazca Railway Stadow Line Sunrise Island Station began operations.

December[]

  • December 3: StarTop Railway Cadence Line extends to Prosand Station.
  • December 4: Nazca Railway Bufly Island Station completed platform expansion of the Stadow Line Section.
  • December 5: Nazca Railway Stadow Line extends to Bufly Island Station.
  • December 17: Nazca Railway Star Island Station completed platform expansion of the Stadow Line Section.
  • December 18: Nazca Railway Stadow Line extends to Star Island Station.
  • December 23: Nazca Railway Sava Line Vanilla Bay Station began operations.

List of Historical Events[]

January[]

  • January 2: Nazca Railway copmleted the inter-railway connecting section between Downtown Transit Upper Maritime Station and Haisan Railway Peninsula Line Karakuri Palace Station.
  • January 6: Nazca Railway Minecraft Line Downdike Bay Station began operations.
  • January 11: Nazca Railway Minecraft Line Edtress Pond Station began operations.
  • January 17: Nazca Railway Minecraft Line Quad-Entryway Station began operations.

February[]

  • February 4: Nazca Railway Minecraft Line, Charlie Line, West Oasis Bay Line, Echo Line Europa Checkpoint began operations. (Echo Line was named Epsilon Line at the time.)
  • February 12: Nazca Railway West Oasis Bay Line Dumbbell Plateau Station began operations. West Oasis Bay Line is established.
  • February 20: Nazca Railway Tat Stone Hill Station completed expansion of the West Oasis Bay Line and Echo Line section and became a Checkpoint.
  • February 21: Nazca Railway West Oasis Bay Line and Echo Line extends to Tat Stone Hill Checkpoint. Echo Line is established.
  • February 23: StarTop Railway Cadence Line Weaving Plate Station completed construction.

March[]

  • March 9: Nazca Railway Cometsilk Line Azure Hook Station began operations.
  • March 16: Nazca Railway Cometsilk Line Comet Channel Station began operations.
  • March 23: Nazca Railway Cometsilk Line Waterbelt Garden Station began operations.
  • March 31: Nazca Railway Cometsilk Line, StarTop Railway Cadence Line Shadow Shore Station began operations (StarTop Railway section commenced services).

April[]

  • April 3: Nazca Railway Cometsilk Line extends to Shadow Shore Station.
  • April 26:
    • Nazca Railway Cometsilk Line, StarTop Railway Cadence Line Echo Cliffs Station began operations（Nazca Railway section commenced services）.
    • Lei Wah Depot completed construction.
  • April 28:
    • StarTop Railway Cadence Line extends to Echo Cliffs Station.
    • Cadence Line Phase I Complete.

May[]

  • May 4: Nazca Railway Stadow Line Ponrest Station began operations.
  • May 8: Nazca Railway Stadow Line Rollhill Island Station began operations.
  • May 13: Nazca Railway Stadow Line Feather Island Station began operations.
  • May 18: Nazca Railway Stadow Line Peanut Island Station began operations.
  • May 21: Nazca Railway Beam Island Station completed platform expansion of the Stadow Line section.
  • May 22: Nazca Railway Stadow Line extends to Beam Island Station.

June[]

  • June 1: Nazca Railway Harvest River Station completed platform expansion of the Cometsilk Line section.
  • June 2: Nazca Railway Cometsilk Line Harvest River Station Branch began operations.
  • June 8: Due to works related to Nazca Railway Katadelphia City Center Node, the Station Souvenir connecting passage of Stadium Line Katadelphia Station is permanently closed.
  • June 10:
    • Nazca Railway The Shuttle Katadelphia City Center Link Katadelphia City Center Node began operations.
    • The platform gates of Stadium Line Katadelphia Station has been upgraded from Basic Platform Gates to Heightened Basic Platform Gates.

July[]

  • July 2: Nazca Railway The Shuttle Media City Link Media City Node began operations.
  • July 6: The platform gates of Nazca Railway Xofa Line Silver Plateau Station has been upgraded from Basic Platform Gates to Heightened Basic Platform Gates.
  • July 10: Nazca Railway Xofa Line Bay Façade Station began operations.
  • July 13:
    • The passage between Nazca Railway Sava Coast Station and Sava Node has been connected.
    • Sava Node and Sava Coast Station have added two exits and one exit respectively.
  • July 21: Nazca Railway Xofa Line, Sparkling Line Crossriver Station began operations.
  • July 29: Nazca Railway Xofa Line, Zephyr Line Xofa Bayside Station began operations.
  • July 31: Nazca Railway Sparkling Line Apperit Station began operations. Sparkling Line is established.

August[]

  • August 1: Project Nazca seventh anniversary.
  • August 7: Nazca Railway Sparkling Line Sparkling North Station began operations.
  • August 8: Sea Sky Railway MetKing Line began services between Red Stadium Park and Bonyal South.
  • August 10: Sea Sky Railway MetKing Line completed construction and began services.
  • August 12: Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line re-started services as Unbalanced Bay Station completed re-construction.
  • August 18: Nazca Railway Zephyr Line Scarlet Spring Station began operations. Zephyr Line is established.
  • August 25: Nazca Railway Zephyr Line Jasmine Beach Station began operations.
  • August 28: Exit C is added at Nazca Railway Stadium Line Anshield Island Station.
  • August 31: Nazca Railway Stadow Line San-loop Station completed construction, but did not begin services until September 9.

September[]

  • September 9: Nazca Railway Stadow Line San-loop Station began operations.
  • September 23: Nazca Railway Compass Island Station completed platform expansion of the Stadow Line section.
  • September 24: Nazca Railway Stadow Line extends to Compass Island Station.

October[]

  • October 11: Lines in Phase 6 of Co-Op Railway are announced.
  • October 13: Nazca Railway Luxter Line Steep Pond Station began operations.
  • October 20: Nazca Railway Luxter Line, Abyss Line Shore Tip Station began operations, but as Sand Martin Checkpoint and Twin Cliffs Station have not yet been built, Abyss Line have yet to extend to Shore Tip Station.
  • October 29: StarTop Railway Cadence Line Warmfox Shoal Station began operations.

November[]

  • November 5:
    • Nazca Railway Luxter Line, Abyss Line, Alpha Line Sand Martin Checkpoint began operations, Alpha Line extends from Zootuary Station to this Station.
    • As Luxter Line tracks have not been connected yet, and Abyss Line Twin Cliffs Station have not yet been built, both lines have yet to extend to Sand Martin Checkpoint.
    • Moreover, Egress Line, Origin Line and Fox Line Platforms have yet to open.
  • November 6: Nazca Railway Luxter Line extends from Shore Tip Station to Sand Martin Checkpoint.
  • November 9: Nazca Railway Abyss Line Twin Cliffs Station began operations, Abyss Line extends from Kong Corner Station to Shore Tip Station.
  • November 17: Nazca Railway eighth anniversary.
  • November 21: Nazca Railway Stadow Line Yashi Island Station began operations.
  • November 25: Nazca Railway Stadow Line War-arc Station began operations.

December[]

  • December 2: Nazca Railway Stadow Line Tenbal Island Station began operations.
  • December 5: Nazca Railway Jessica Island Station completed platform expansion of the Stadow Line section.
  • December 6: Nazca Railway Stadow Line extends to Jessica Island Station.
  • December 21: Nazca Railway Stadow Line Trapezium Island Station began operations.
  • December 22: West Oasis Bay Line merged with Oasis Bay Line.
  • December 24: Nazca Railway Stadow Line Freedom Bay Station began operations, Stadow Line extends to Europa Checkpoint.

2020 is the sixth year since Los Sengas was created.

Unless otherwise specified, all events that are described below took place in Los Sengas.

《2018 2019 2020 2021 2022》

Contents

  • 1 List of Historical Events
    • 1.1 January
    • 1.2 February
    • 1.3 March
    • 1.4 April
    • 1.5 May
    • 1.6 June
    • 1.7 July
    • 1.8 August
    • 1.9 September
    • 1.10 October
    • 1.11 November
    • 1.12 December
  • 2 Citations and References

List of Historical Events[]

January[]

  • January 1: Nazca Railway Oasis Bay Line Top Hill Bay Station began operations.
  • January 6: Nazca Railway Oasis Bay Line Up Clearings Station began operations.
  • January 9: Oasis Bay became District 24 of Los Sengas, and the Original District 24 (Xofa) became District 25.
  • January 10: Nazca Railway Oasis Bay Line Down Clearings Station began operations.
  • January 12: Nazca Railway Oasis Bay Line Charm River Station began operations.
  • January 15: Nazca Railway Oasis Bay Line Strange Channel Station began operations.
  • January 19: The Nazca Railway 2020+ Plans are announced.
  • January 23: ACR Rhombus Sand Station completed construction, Prosand and Rhombus Sand began operations.
  • January 24: Nazca Railway Oasis Bay Line Bottom Woods Station began operations, Oasis Bay Line is connected between Southern Heights Station and Europa Checkpoint.
  • January 31: StarTop Railway Cadence Line Flask North Station began operations.

February[]

  • February 5: NAR Southern Corridor Chimes Canyon Station began operations.
  • February 8: Nazca Railway Stadow Line Io Station began operations.
  • February 16: Nazca Railway Origin Line Kamelen Station began operations, Origin Line began stopping at that Station.
  • February 21: Nazca Railway Origin Line Station of Friendship began operations.
  • February 22: Chinese Express Yowah Line Prosand Station completed first reconstruction.
  • February 26: Nazca Railway Origin Line Far River Station began operations.

March[]

  • March 2:
    • The Nazca Railway Stadium Line section between Anshield Island Station and Info Island Station was destroyed. As a result, services between Bulldoze Island Station and Middle Island Station were suspended. However, the section has since been recovered
    • Nazca Railway Origin Line, Egress Line Banyan Station began operations.
  • March 3:
    • Nazca Railway Origin Line and Egress Line extended from Banyan Station to Sand Martin Checkpoint.
    • Starshore became District 26 of Los Sengas.
  • March 4: Nazca Railway Fox Line extended from Flask North Station to Sand Martin Checkpoint.
  • March 8: Chinese Express Yowah Line Cyan Loop Station completed first reconstruction.
  • March 9: Nazca Railway Egress Line Bowplate River Station began operations.
  • March 12: Nazca Railway Egress Line Three Line Island Station began operations.
  • March 17: Nazca Railway Egress Line Mount Egress Station began operations.
  • March 19: Nazca Railway Egress Line Wan Toi City Station began operations, Egress Line is connected between Rapid Rivulet Station and Banyan Station.
  • March 23: Nazca Railway began updating signage to SignPicture.
  • March 31: StarTop Railway Cadence Line Flask West Station began operations.

April[]

  • April 4: Nazca Railway updating progress has exceeded 25%.
  • April 10: Clouds became District 27 of Los Sengas.
  • April 15: Nazca Railway Stadow Line Mosaic North Station began operations.
  • April 18: Nazca Railway Stadow Line Arcgo North Island Station began operations.
  • April 20: NR Buses is established alongside Route R41.
  • April 22: Nazca Railway Arcgo Line, Mushroom Transit (Then Frosview Railway) Samui Line Cooace Hill Station began operations.
  • April 23:
    • The Three Pass Station completed concourse expansion. 6 Shops are added outside the Fare Area, and a bus terminus is added outside the station.
    • Mushroom Transit (Then Frosview Railway) Samui Line Circle Pit Station began operations. Samui Line is established.
  • April 24:
    • NR Buses Route R20 is established.
    • NR Buses Route R20A is established.
  • April 25:
    • Nazca Railway New Edward Line Twenty Village Station began operations.
    • Mushroom Transit (Then Frosview Railway) Samui Line Fearless Forest Station began operations.
  • April 26: Nazca Railway began preparation works for elevatizion of Stadium Line between Grass Crack Station and Kong Corner Station.
  • April 27:
    • Nazca Railway Stadium Line Blackstone Village Station began operations.
    • Elevatizion works are completed for Nazca Railway Stadium Line section between Grass Crack Station and Kong Corner Station.
  • April 28: Mushroom Transit (Then Frosview Railway) Samui Line, Royal Railway Eastern Line Skycold Rivulet Station began operations.
  • April 29: Nazca Railway updating progress has exceeded 50%.
  • April 30: Mushroom Transit (Then Frosview Railway) Samui Line Ingress South Station began operations.

May[]

  • May 1:
    • Project Nazca Terracept now permanently open.
    • Royal Railway Eastern Line Vertow Valley Station began operations. Eastern Line is established.
  • May 3:
    • Nazca Railway Belt Island Station second expansion complete.
    • Nazca Railway Oasis Bay Line Top Hill Bay Station Exit C added.
  • May 5:
    • Nazca Railway Prosand Station began operations of the node part, and The Shuttle Prosand Link began operations.
    • NR Buses Route 54 is established.
  • May 8: Nazca Railway The Shuttle Midway Island Link Midway Island Node began operations.
  • May 9: Royal Railway Eastern Line Cold Stream Station began operations.
  • May 11: Nazca Railway The Shuttle Old Brightland Link Old Brightland Node began operations.
  • May 17: Nazca Railway West Ring Line Outer Ring now stops at Metro Stone Station. Metro Stone Station is now a compulsory stop for both directions of West Ring Line.
  • May 19: Nazca Railway Origin Line Wilde Street Station began operations. At the same day, Origin Line extended from Metropolis Terminal to that Station.
  • May 21: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Lower Shack Station began operations.
  • May 27: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Flashsand Station began operations.
  • May 28: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Sunflower Garden Station began operations.
  • May 31: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Whitecliff Village Station began operations.

June[]

  • June 1: Project Nazca Golden World now Permanently Open.
  • June 5: Nazca Railway East Ring Line Daisy Island Station began operations.
  • June 9: Nazca Railway Daring Line Clearbrook Station began operations.
  • June 14:
    • Nazca Railway Daring Line Shek Pai Tau Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway Sava Line Venus Street Station completed expansion and added 2 exits.
    • Nazca Railway Stadium Line Katadelphia Station completed expansion and added 1 exit.
  • June 19:
    • Nazca Railway Daring Line Bondhill Curves Station began operations.
    • Phase I of Nazca Railway SignPicture updating works complete.

July[]

  • July 8: Nazca Railway Daring Line extended, Centopia Phase I began operations.
  • July 10: Mushroom Transit (Then Frosview Railway) Samui Line Frostspring Valley Station began operations.
  • July 12: Nazca Railway Daring Line Durandal Station began operations.
  • July 13:
    • Mushroom Transit (Then Frosview Railway) Samui Line Steep Pond Station began operations.
    • Mushroom Transit (Then Frosview Railway) Samui Line Karakuri Palace Station began operations.
  • July 15: Nazca Railway Daring Line Quillow Terrace Station began operations.
  • July 18: Nazca Railway Daring Line Le Monde Station began operations.
  • July 27:
    • Nazca Railway Alpha Line extended to Centopia.
    • Nazca Railway Stadium Line Blackstone Village Station added Exit B connecting to Sava Light Transit.
  • July 31: Nazca Railway Sava Line, Golf Line Horsepower Island Station began operations. Golf Line is established.

August[]

  • August 1: Project Nazca eighth anniversary.
  • August 2:
    • Peckern Metro announced that Metro Line will feature in-train transfer with Chinese Express Yowah Line in order to facilitate travel between east Los Sengas and Metropolis Terminal, as well as to reduce passenger load for Stadium Line.
    • Creeper Railway Pure Water Line Waterbelt Garden Station completed construction.
    • Creeper Railway Pure Water Line Gentle Island Station began operations. Pure Water Line is established.
  • August 3: Nazca Railway Pegasus Line, Epsilon Line Snipe Valley Station began operations. However, as Pegasus Line has yet to start development, Pegasus Line platforms have yet to begin operations.
  • August 6: Nazca Railway Kinight Line Voycrane Station began operations.
  • August 9: Nazca Railway Old Brightland Station completed platform expansion of the Akashi Line, Daybreaker Line section, as well as South Concourse and West Concourse.
  • August 12: Nazca Railway Akashi Line, Daybreaker Line Myosotis Valley Station began operations. Akashi Line, Daybreaker Line are established.
  • August 15: Nazca Railway Daybreaker Line Anjou Station began operations.
  • August 16: Nazca Railway Daybreaker Line Callahan Station began operations.
  • August 19: Nazca Railway Daybreaker Line Firewood Point Station began operations.
  • August 22:
    • Nazca Railway Urban Line, Akashi Line Seraphynx Station began operations.
    • Chinese Express Yowah Line Fosina Station completed reconstruction.
  • August 24: Nazca Railway Akashi Line Minstrel Woods Station began operations.
  • August 25: Nazca Railway Mei Fwong Station completed platform expansion of Akashi Line section.
  • August 26: Nazca Railway Akashi Line extends to Mei Fwong Station.
  • August 27: Royal Railway Eastern Line Under Hill Station began operations.
  • August 29: Nazca Railway Akashi Line Walnut Tree Station began operations.
  • August 30: Nazca Railway Downdike Bay Station completed platform and underground concoruse expansion of the Akashi Line section. At the same day, Akashi Line extends to Downdike Bay Station.

September[]

  • September 1: Nazca Railway Akashi Line Sharp Spit Station began operations.
  • September 2: Nazca Railway Freedom Bay Station completed platform expansion of the Akashi Line section. At the same day, Akashi Line extends to Freedom Bay Station.
  • September 4: Royal Railway Eastern Line Twisnow Station began operations.
  • September 5: Nazca Railway Shore Tip LRT Tung Wik Line, Ting Wik Line Lei Wik Estate Stop completed construction.
  • September 6: Nazca Railway Shore Tip LRT Tung Wik Line Shore Tip Exhibition Center Stop began operations. Tung Wik Line is established, and became the first LRT line of Nazca Railway.
  • September 8: Nazca Railway Shore Tip LRT Tung Wik Line Shore Tip Stop began operations.
  • September 9: Peckern Metro Metro Line completed tracks between Metropolis and Fosina.
  • September 10:
    • Nazca Railway Shore Tip LRT Tung Wik Line Terutsuki Hotel Stop began operations.
    • StarTop Railway Cadence Line Aest Station began operations.
  • September 12: Nazca Railway Shore Tip LRT Tung Wik Line Tooth Cliff Government Complex Stop began operations.
  • September 13: Nazca Railway Shore Tip LRT Tung Wik Line Chung Ngai Road Stop began operations.
  • September 16: Nazca Railway Shore Tip LRT Tung Wik Line, Ting Wik Line Tung Ngai Garden Stop began operations.
  • September 18: Nazca Railway Shore Tip LRT Ting Wik Line Tooth Cliff DT Station Stop began operations. Ting Wik Line is established.
  • September 19: Nazca Railway Shore Tip LRT Ting Wik Line Hoi Ting Road Stop began operations.
  • September 22: Nazca Railway Shore Tip LRT Ting Wik Line Lan Ting Road Stop began operations.
  • September 25: Nazca Railway Shore Tip LRT Ting Wik Line Yiu Yuet Road Stop began operations.
  • September 26: Nazca Railway Shore Tip LRT Ting Wik Line Jing Gok SLT Station Stop began operations.
  • September 27: Nazca Railway Shore Tip LRT Ting Wik Line Hoi Ngon Road Stop began operations.
  • September 29: Nazca Railway Shore Tip LRT Ting Wik Line Next Building Stop and Sing Zaak SLT Station Stop began operations.

October[]

  • October 4: Nazca Railway Minecraft Line Galactic River Station began operations.
  • October 6: Nazca Railway Oasis Bay Line Pinestand Station began operations.
  • October 10: Nazca Railway Oasis Bay Line Grandview Bay Station began operations.
  • October 13: Nazca Railway Glacier Line Causeway Bay Station began operations.
  • October 17: Nazca Railway Glacier Line Qoser Coast Station began operations.
  • October 20: Nazca Railway Glacier Line Royal Mount Station began operations.
  • October 25:
    • Nazca Railway Glacier Line Virtue Plateau Station began operations.
    • Snowty became District 28 of Los Sengas.
  • October 29: Nazca Railway Glacier Line Quinty Station began operations.

November[]

  • November 1: Nazca Railway Glacier Line Lingshan North Station began operations.
  • November 5: Nazca Railway Glacier Line Bamboo Lake Station began operations.
  • November 14: Nazca Railway Glacier Line Icy Lava Station began operations.
  • November 17:
    • Nazca Railway ninth anniversary.
    • Nazca Railway Glacier Line Snowty North Station began operations.
  • November 22:
    • Nazca Railway Glacier Line Snowdan Island Station began operations.
    • Asylum became District 29 of Los Sengas.
  • November 26: Nazca Railway Glacier Line TriVillage South Station began operations.

December[]

  • December 2: Nazca Railway Glacier Line Arctic Sea Station began operations.
  • December 5: Nazca Railway Glacier Line Barode Cave Station began operations.
  • December 9:
    • Nazca Railway Glacier Line Lucky Pit Station began operations.
    • Coopol became District 30 of Los Sengas.
  • December 12: Nazca Railway Glacier Line Key River Station began operations.
  • December 17: Nazca Railway Glacier Line Glaciss Station began operations.
  • December 20: Nazca Railway Glacier Line Coopol Station began operations.
  • December 27: Cities Transit Peckern City Circular Dufol Station began operations.

Unless otherwise specified, all events that are described below took place in Los Sengas.

《2019 2020 2021 2022 2023》

Contents

    • 1.1 January
    • 1.2 February
