List of Historical Events[]

January[]

  • January 1 (Friday): Nazca Railway Coast Edge Station completed platform expansion of Swift Line section.
  • January 3 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Swift Line Novel Station began operations. Swift Line is established.
  • January 5 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Polibiomes Station completed platform expansion of Swift Line section, Swift Line extended to Polibiomes Station.
  • January 6 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Ingress South Station completed expansion and added Exit B.
  • January 7 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Swift Line South Field Station began operations.
  • January 8 (Friday):
    • Winsol became District 30 of Los Sengas.
    • Coopol became District 31 of Los Sengas.
    • Intus Aquilo became District 34 of Los Sengas.
  • January 10 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Swift Line Vincere Road Station began operations.
  • January 11 (Monday): Nazca Railway completed expansion of High Approach Station, with a concourse, 9 exits and a set of Island Platforms added for Swift Line.
  • January 12 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Swift Line extended to High Approach Station.
  • January 15 (Friday): Nazca Railway Swift Line Gravel Pit Station began operations.
  • January 16 (Saturday): StarTop Railway Cadence Line Ionic Compass Station began operations.
  • January 18 (Monday): Nazca Railway Swift Line Vayler North Station began operations.
  • January 20 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Vayler Station completed platform expansion of Swift Line. At the same day, Swift Line extended to Vayler Station, Swift Line completed construction.
  • January 27 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Akashi Line, Vision Line Diamond Pool Station began operations.
  • January 30 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Akashi Line Anne Park Station began operations.

February[]

  • February 3 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway completed expansion of Sheung Che Nung Station, and opened Kinight Line platforms (Kinight Line has not extended to this station).
  • February 7 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Akashi Line Red Millet Station began operations.
  • February 9 (Tuesday):
    • NR Buses Route 340 is established.
    • NR Buses Route 341S is established.
  • February 11 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Kinight Line Hexrep Station began operations.
  • February 18 (Thursday):
    • Nazca Railway Kinight Line, Akashi Line, Bravo Line Darey Terrace Station began operations, but as Bravo Line tracks have not been connected, Bravo Line have yet to extend to Darey Terrace Station.
    • Nazca Railway Kinight Line Sheung Che Nung Branch began operations.
  • February 19 (Friday): Nazca Railway Bravo Line extended to Darey Terrace Station.
  • February 24 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Akashi Line Rosifolius Station began operations.
  • February 26 (Friday): Nazca Railway Python Delta Station completed expansion of Akashi Line section. Akashi Line extended to Python Delta Station, and this marked the completion of Akashi Line Phase II.

March[]

  • March 2 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Vision Line Long Bay Station began operations. Vision Line is established.
  • March 7 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Vision Line Lorepine Station began operations.
  • March 10 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Akashi Line, Daybreaker Line, Vision Line Diamond Pool Depot completed construction.
  • March 17 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Sexterade LRT Sheung Yam Line, Tsing Lam Line Sheung Che Nung Stop completed construction.
  • March 19 (Friday): Nazca Railway Sexterade LRT Tsing Lam Line Serenade Stop began operations. Tsing Lam Line is established.
  • March 22 (Monday): Nazca Railway Sexterade LRT Tsing Lam Line Kou Fu Sui Stop began operations.
  • March 26 (Friday): Nazca Railway Sexterade LRT Tsing Lam Line Fu Yi Terrace Stop began operations.
  • March 27 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Sexterade LRT Tsing Lam Line Sexterade Promenade Stop began operations.

April[]

  • April 1 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Sexterade LRT Pak Kei Line, Sheung Yam Line, Tsing Lam Line Smokemist Street Stop began operations.
  • April 3 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Sexterade LRT Pak Kei Line, Tsing Lam Line Sandy Heights NAR Station Stop began operations. Pak Kei Line is established.
  • April 4 (Sunday): Cities Transit Peckern City Circular Treeless Hill Station began operations.
  • April 7 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Sexterade LRT Pak Kei Line, Tsing Lam Line Sexterade Town Hall Stop began operations.
  • April 10 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Sexterade LRT Pak Kei Line, Tsing Lam Line Sexterade Pier Head Stop began operations. Tsing Lam Line completed construction.
  • April 13 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Sexterade LRT Pak Kei Line Tai Nung Plains Stop completed construction.
  • April 17 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Sexterade LRT Pak Kei Line, Sheung Yam Line The Acacian Stop began operations.
  • April 21 (Wednesday):
    • Nazca Railway East Ring Line To commemorate the game "Apex Legends", Apex Station and Apex East Station Station changed to their current english names. This is also the first instance of a station changing names after construction since Fansim Island.
    • Nazca Railway Sexterade LRT Pak Kei Line Wah Hon Estate Stop began operations.
  • April 25 (Sunday):
    • Nazca Railway Sexterade LRT Pak Kei Line Kashiwazaki Road Stop began operations.
    • Pak Kei Line extended to Sexterade Pier Head Stop, Pak Kei Line completed construction.

May[]

  • May 1 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Sexterade LRT Sheung Yam Line Skuld Road Garden Stop began operations. Sheung Yam Line is established and extended to The Acacian Stop.
  • May 4 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Sexterade LRT Sheung Yam Line St. Louis Garden Stop began operations.
  • May 7 (Friday): Nazca Railway Sexterade LRT Sheung Yam Line Yam Ling Court Stop began operations and extended to Smokemist Street Stop. Sheung Yam Line completed construction.
  • May 9 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Xofa Line changed to its current name from the original "Xofa Crescent", and the line number changed from 5C to 5A.
  • May 11 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway East Ring Line finished changing signage at Apex Station and Apex East Station.
  • May 13 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Xofa Line finished changing signage.
  • May 15 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Java Beach Station completed expansion of Utopia Line Platform 4 section.
  • May 18 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Utopia Line Chromafringe Station began operations. Utopia Line is established. However, Utopia Line has yet to extend to Centopia.
  • May 19 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Utopia Line extended to Centopia, Utopia Line Phase I completed construction.
  • May 26 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Sava Line Dragonire Bay Station began operations.
  • May 30 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Sava Line Gunshot Island Station began operations.
  • May 30 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Sava Line, Flask Line Peacean Island Station began construction.

June[]

  • June 2 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Sava Line, Flask Line Peacean Island Station began operations.
  • June 4 (Friday): Nazca Railway Sava Line extended from Gunshot Island Station to Peacean Island Station. However, as Artillery Island Station have yet to be onstructed, Flask Line did not extend to Peacean Island Station.
  • June 5 (Saturday): Creeper Railway Pure Water Line Waterbelt River Station began operations.
  • June 9 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Flask Line Artillery Island Station began operations, Flask Line extended from Glacier Station to Peacean Island Station.
  • June 11 (Friday): Creeper Railway Pure Water Line Gentle Island Pond Station began operations.
  • June 14 (Monday): Nazca Railway Stadium Line Woyi Gap Station began operations.
  • June 18 (Friday): Nazca Railway Stadium Line Plum Hill Station began operations.
  • June 21 (Monday): Nazca Railway Stadium Line Jumper Swamp Station began operations.
  • June 24 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Stadium Line Chosen Surge Station began operations.
  • June 29 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Stadium Line Sandviched Hill Station began operations.

July[]

  • July 1 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Stadium Line Whitestone Village Station began operations.
  • July 8 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Xofa Line, Fox Line Silver Plateau Station completed expansion of the new concourse.
  • July 11 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Dansein Market Station completed expansion of the Glinstrouß Line section.
  • July 16 (Friday): Nazca Railway Bondhill Curves Station completed expansion of the Glinstrouß Line and began operations. Glinstrouß Line is established.
  • July 19 (Monday): Nazca Railway Glinstrouß Line Mount Hittites Station began operations.
  • July 24 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Glinstrouß Line, Everchord Line Ramseqeu Station began operations.
  • July 28 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Glinstrouß Line, Everchord Line Tin Kam Station began operations. Everchord Line is established.
  • July 31 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Glinstrouß Line Bulbacon Station began operations.

August[]

  • August 1 (Sunday): Project Nazca ninth anniversary.
  • August 4 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Arcgo Line North Coast Road Station began operations.
  • August 9 (Monday): Nazca Railway Arcgo Line Havenore Station began operations.
  • August 14 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Arcgo Line Fall Point Gateway began operations.
  • August 20 (Friday): Nazca Railway Glinstrouß Line Halcedon Station began operations.
  • August 24 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Everchord Line Grand Junction Station began operations.
  • August 27 (Friday): Nazca Railway Le Monde Checkpoint completed expansion of the New Edward Line, Akashi Line and Bravo Line platforms, Bravo Line extended to Le Monde Checkpoint. However, as New Edward Line and Akashi Line have yet to construct the stations reaching Le Monde Checkpoint, New Edward Line, Akashi Line did not extend to Le Monde Checkpoint.

September[]

  • September 3 (Friday): Nazca Railway New Edward Line Kallen Bay Station began operations.
  • September 7 (Monday): Nazca Railway Quillow Terrace Station completed platform expansion of the New Edward Line section, New Edward Line extended to Le Monde Checkpoint.
  • September 19 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Akashi Line Eclipse Fields Station began operations.
  • September 25 (Saturday):
    • Nazca Railway Akashi Line Peace Boulevard Station began operations.
    • Cities Transit Peckern City Circular Peckern Park Station began operations.

October[]

  • October 3 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Akashi Line Craneplaz Station began operations.
  • October 6 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Akashi Line Astral City Station began operations.
  • October 7 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Akashi Line extended to Le Monde Checkpoint.
  • October 16 (Saturday): Cities Transit Peckern City Circular Purple Gate Station began operations.
  • October 17 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Akashi Line Summer Point Gateway began operations. Akashi Line completed construction.
  • October 31 (Sunday):
    • Nazca Railway The Shuttle Wui King Link Wui King Node began operations.
    • Creeper Railway Pure Water Line Purity Forest Station began operations.
    • Creeper Railway Pure Water Line Purity Corner Station began operations. Pure Water Line completed construction.

November[]

  • November 6 (Saturday): Nazca Railway The Shuttle Central Numpool Link Central Numpool Node began operations.
  • November 17 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway tenth anniversary.
  • November 23 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Stadium Line Sandviched Hill Station is renamed Apple Hill Station.
  • November 28 (Sunday): Odyssey became District 33 of Los Sengas.
  • November 29 (Monday): Nazca Railway Minecraft Line, Wanderer Line Cranerock Mount Station began operations.

December[]

  • December 5 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Minecraft Line, Charlie Line Potato Farmland Station began operations.
  • December 10 (Friday): Nazca Railway Smelting Bay Station completed expansion of Wanderer Line section.
  • December 15 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Wanderer Line Blossom Ages Station began operations. Wanderer Line is established.
  • December 19 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Wanderer Line Oldon Town Station began operations.
  • December 27 (Monday): Nazca Railway Wanderer Line Recuérdame Station began operations, Wanderer Line extended to Cranerock Mount Station.
  • December 31 (Friday): Nazca Railway Wanderer Line Markost Station began operations.

safeHtml:
2022 is the eighth year since Los Sengas was created.

Unless otherwise specified, all events that are described below took place in Los Sengas.

《2020 2021 2022 2023 2024》

Contents

  • 1 List of Historical Events
    • 1.1 January
    • 1.2 February
    • 1.3 March
    • 1.4 April
    • 1.5 May
    • 1.6 June
    • 1.7 July
    • 1.8 August
    • 1.9 September
    • 1.10 October
    • 1.11 November
    • 1.12 December
  • 2 Citations and References

List of Historical Events[]

January[]

  • January 8 (Saturday): Nazca Railway New Edward Line, Cometsilk Line Hillfield Station began operations. However, as Shatterpass Station have not yet been built, New Edward Line did not extend to Hillfield Station.
  • January 13 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Cometsilk Line, Delta Line Hillfield Station began operations.
  • January 14 (Friday): Nazca Railway Delta Line extends to Hillfield Station.
  • January 17 (Monday): Nazca Railway Cometsilk Line Afflushore Station began operations.
  • January 23 (Sunday):
    • Nazca Railway Cometsilk Line Welliant Plateau Station began operations.
    • Chinese Express Yowah Line Cyan Loop Station completed second reconstruction.
  • January 28 (Friday): Nazca Railway Cometsilk Line Milky Realm Station began operations. Cometsilk Line formed a complete ring and completed construction.

February[]

  • February 1 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway New Edward Line Shatterpass Station began operations. At the same day, New Edward Line extends to Hillfield Station.
  • February 11 (Friday): Nazca Railway Metropolis Terminal Phase VI completed construction.
  • February 14 (Monday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line started services between Metropolis Terminal and Wilde Street Station, Pegasus Line is established.
  • February 23 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line Spring Stone Station began operations.
  • February 26 (Saturday): StarTop Railway Cadence Line Vein Lake Station began operations, Cadence Line Phase II Complete.
  • February 28 (Monday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line, Phoenix Line Sincerity Cove Station began operations, but as Phoenix Line have yet to begin development, Phoenix Line did not begin operations.

March[]

  • March 2 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway completed redrawing all Online Map markers.
  • March 3 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Seat River Station completed expansion of the Pegasus Line section.
  • March 4 (Friday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line extends to Seat River Station.
  • March 5 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line extends to Central Numpool Station.
  • March 7 (Monday): Nazca Railway Miner North Station completed expansion of the Pegasus Line section.
  • March 8 (Tuesday):
    • Nazca Railway Pegasus Line extends to Miner North Station.
    • Mushroom Transit (Then Frosview Railway) Samui Line completed reconstruction between Cooace Hill Station and Ingress South Station.
    • Mushroom Transit (Then Frosview Railway) Samui Line began operations between Kita-sakari Garden Station and Fluoride Plain Station.
  • March 10 (Thursday): Nazca Railway TriPaw Station completed expansion of the Pegasus Line section.
  • March 11 (Friday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line extends to TriPaw Station.
  • March 17 (Thursday): StarTop Railway Cadence Line Twin Cliffs Station began operations.
  • March 18 (Friday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line Colon Station began operations.
  • March 20 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Old Brightland Station completed expansion of the Pegasus Line and Lima Line sections.
  • March 21 (Monday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line extends to Old Brightland Station, but as Lima Line have yet to begin development, Lima Line did not begin operations.
  • March 22 (Tuesday):
    • Los Sengas reorganized its districts:
      • District 0 "Centopia Area and Aurora Isles" became Centopia.
      • Odyssey became District 35 of Los Sengas.
      • Prymea became District 36 of Los Sengas.
      • Festival became District 37 of Los Sengas.
  • March 23 (Wednesday): Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line began operations between Victorion Station and Mount Wetlands Station.
  • March 25 (Friday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line Snowfall Valley Station began operations.
  • March 27 (Sunday):
    • Nazca Railway Pegasus Line Galileo Heights Station began operations.
    • PTT. Railway Greenwood Line Smelting Bay Station completed construction.
  • March 29 (Tuesday): Mushroom Transit (Then Frosview Railway) Samui Line Frostspring Valley Station completed reconstruction.
  • March 30 (Wednesday):
    • Nawis Railway Labyrinth Line Europa Station completed construction.
    • Nawis Railway Labyrinth Line Cervibell Station began operations. Labyrinth Line is established.
    • Nawis Railway Labyrinth Line Tsui Ping Station began operations.
    • PTT. Railway Greenwood Line Oldon Town Station began operations. Greenwood Line is established.
    • Mushroom Transit (Then Frosview Railway) Samui Line Steep Pond Station completed reconstruction.
    • Mushroom Transit (Then Frosview Railway) Samui Line Karakuri Palace Station completed reconstruction.
  • March 31 (Thursday):
    • Nawis Railway Labyrinth Line Lorepine Station began operations.
    • Mushroom Transit (Then Frosview Railway) Samui Line Three Line Island Station began operations.

April[]

  • April 2 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Up Clearings Station completed expansion of the Pegasus Line section. At the same day, Pegasus Line extends to Up Clearings Station.
  • April 4 (Monday):
    • Chinese Express Yowah Line Prosand Station completed second reconstruction.
    • Nawis Railway Southern Corridor, Labyrinth Line Python Delta Station began operations.
  • April 6 (Wednesday):
    • Nawis Railway Labyrinth Line Nagasora Station began operations.
    • Mushroom Transit (Then Frosview Railway) Samui Line Mercury Sea Station began operations.
  • April 7 (Thursday): PTT. Railway Greenwood Line, Nawis Railway Snow White Line Stamford Station began operations.
  • April 8 (Friday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line Everbond Station began operations. At the same day, Pegasus Line extends to Snipe Valley Station.
  • April 16 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Interisland Line Arcgo West Island Station began operations, but the Glinstrouß Line platforms did not begin operations.
  • April 22 (Friday): PTT. Railway Greenwood Line Dumbbell Plateau Station began operations.
  • April 23 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Stadow Line Goalkeep Corner Station began operations.
  • April 25 (Monday): Nazca Railway The Rusty's Inn began operations.
  • April 27 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Smelting Bay Station completed expansion of the Pegasus Line section.
  • April 28 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line extends to Smelting Bay Station, Pegasus Line Phase I complete.

May[]

  • May 3 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Daybreaker Line Stivali Peninsula Station began operations.
  • May 4 (Wednesday):
    • Los Sengas reorganized its districts:
      • Airship Island was swallowed by Peckern and Twenty-Second Continent.
      • Centopia became District 21 of Los Sengas.
      • Starshore was swallowed by Oasis and Prymea.
      • Prymea became District 26 of Los Sengas.
      • Goldpoint became District 36 of Los Sengas.
  • May 10 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Sharpness Plains Station completed platform expansion of the Daybreaker Line section.
  • May 11 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Daybreaker Line extends to Sharpness Plains Station.
  • May 14 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Daybreaker Line Roundy Basin Station began operations.
  • May 18 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Upper Oasis Station completed platform expansion of the Daybreaker Line section. At the same day, Daybreaker Line extends to Upper Oasis Station.
  • May 22 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line Origin Court Station began operations.
  • May 28 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line Samenta Station began operations. However, the Origin Line platforms at that station remain closed.

June[]

  • June 4 (Saturday):
    • Nazca Railway Pegasus Line, Phoenix Line Candor Plains Station began operations, but as Phoenix Line have yet to begin development, Phoenix Line did not extend to Candor Plains Station.
    • All NR Dex have been created.
  • June 7 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line Lens Station began operations.
  • June 8 (Wednesday): Nawis Railway Labyrinth Line Zenoridge Station began operations.
  • June 9 (Thursday): Chinese Express Yowah Line Candor Plains Station began operations.
  • June 11 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line Mast Pit Station began operations.
  • June 16 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line Eastbiome Station began operations.
  • June 18 (Saturday): Nawis Railway Labyrinth Line Hawthorn Station began operations.
  • June 21 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line extends to Pale Rivering Station.
  • June 24 (Friday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line extends to Coast Edge Station.
  • June 26 (Sunday): Cities Transit Peckern City Circular Senriyama Station began operations.
  • June 29 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line Canusoar Cape Station began operations.

July[]

  • July 3 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line Portubra Island Station began operations.
  • July 4 (Monday): Nazca Railway Peacean Island Station completed expansion, adding several transfer passageways and a set of stacked side platforms for Pegasus Line. At the same day, Pegasus Line extends to Peacean Island Station, Pegasus Line Phase II complete.
  • July 7 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Flask East Station became a Checkpoint.
  • July 14 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Mei Fwong Station added Exit E.
  • July 17 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Samenta Station Origin Line section open, Origin Line begin stopping at that Station.
  • July 24 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line Luk Tsuen Station began operations, Phoenix Line is established.
  • July 25 (Monday): Nazca Railway Cyan Loop Station began expansion.
  • July 26 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Cyan Loop Station completed expansion, adding a concourse, 4 exits and two side platforms for Charlie Line emergency use, as well as another set of stacked side platforms for Phoenix Line.
  • July 27 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line extends to Cyan Loop Station.
  • July 29 (Friday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line extends to Candor Plains Station.
  • July 31 (Sunday):
    • Mushroom Transit (Then Frosview Railway) Samui Line Tashi Island Station began operations.
    • Mushroom Transit (Then Frosview Railway) Samui Line Ice-Flamelute Station began operations. Samui Line Phase I completed construction.

August[]

  • August 1 (Monday):
    • Project Nazca tenth anniversary.
    • Nazca Railway Phoenix Line extends to Fosina Station.
    • StarTop Railway Cadence Line Peachem Flatland Station and Vector Bay Station completed construction. Cadence Line Phase III complete. Cadence Line completed construction.
  • August 3 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Stadium Line Kata River Station added a park and a few NR Shops.
  • August 4 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line, Epsilon Line Snipe Valley Station Exit C open, and added Exit F connecting to the Public Transport Interchange at Ground level.
  • August 7 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line Wisely Station began operations.
  • August 11 (Thursday):
    • Nazca Railway Flask East Checkpoint finished third expansion.
    • Nazca Railway Flask North Station completed expansion.
  • August 12 (Friday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line extends to Flask East Checkpoint.
  • August 19 (Friday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line Spring Lakeny Station began operations.
  • August 26 (Friday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line Allied Town Station began operations.

September[]

  • September 4 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line Lei Tiu Lau Station began operations.
  • September 9 (Friday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line extends to Rectime Bay Station.
  • September 16 (Friday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line Victorion Station began operations.
  • September 21 (Friday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line Dreamers Station began operations.
  • September 27 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line Stardust Station began operations.

October[]

  • October 1 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line extends to Warm Cairn Station.
  • October 2 (Sunday): CTRD Peckern City Circular Landing Pole Station began operations, Peckern City Circular Phase II complete.
  • October 5 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line extends to Nail Bight Checkpoint.
  • October 8 (Saturday): Nawis Railway Labyrinth Line, Snow White Line Potato Farmland Station began operations.
  • October 9 (Sunday): NAR Labyrinth Line Potato Farmland Station began operations, Labyrinth Line Phase II Complete.
  • October 14 (Friday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line Monley Coast Station began operations.
  • October 16 (Sunday): Phase II of Nazca Railway SignPicture updating works complete.
  • October 21 (Friday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line extends to Hillfield Station.
  • October 25 (Tuesday): Nawis Railway Snow White Line Kimberley Station began operations. Snow White Line is established.
  • October 28 (Friday): Nawis Railway Snow White Line extends to Stamford Station.
  • October 29 (Saturday): Cities Transit Peckern South-East Coast Line Purple Gate Station and Neargull Station began operations. Peckern South-East Coast Line is established.
  • October 31 (Monday): Nawis Railway Snow White Line Tat Stone Hill Station began operations.

November[]

  • November 1 (Tuesday): Nawis Railway Snow White Line Abysmal Bay Station began operations.
  • November 2 (Wednesday): Cities Transit Peckern South-East Coast Line Senriyama Bridge Station began operations.
  • November 3 (Thursday):
    • Nazca Railway Stadow Line Zenoridge Station began operations.
    • Nawis Railway Snow White Line Snipe Valley Station began operations.
    • Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line began operations between Hammer Bay Station and Grassharp Station.
  • November 6 (Sunday):
    • Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line began operations between Rapid Rivulet Station and Out Sand Station.
    • Cities Transit Peckern South-East Coast Line extends to Senriyama Station.
  • November 7 (Monday): Nawis Railway Snow White Line Everbond Station began operations.
  • November 8 (Tuesday): Nawis Railway Snow White Line Suez Station began operations.
  • November 10 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Stadow Line Hawthorn Station began operations.
  • November 11 (Friday): Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Rapid extends to Rapid Rivulet Station.
  • November 12 (Saturday):
    • Nawis Railway Snow White Line, Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line Tea Pond Station began operations.
    • Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line began operations between Mansgrove Station and North Wooden Abyss Station.
  • November 13 (Sunday):
    • Nazca Railway Pegasus Line Flagter Station began operations.
    • Nawis Railway Snow White Line, Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line Howard Canyon Station began operations.
    • Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line Wooden Abyss Station began operations.
  • November 14 (Monday): Nawis Railway Snow White Line Ventenia Station began operations.
  • November 15 (Tuesday): Nawis Railway Snow White Line Mount Spadrago Station began operations.
  • November 17 (Thursday): Nawis Railway Snow White Line High Lagoon Station began operations.
  • November 20 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line Rose Garden Station began operations.

December[]

  • December 1 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Minecraft Line, Pegasus Line Trisob Bay Station began operations, but Pegasus Line did not extend to Trisob Bay Station.
  • December 2 (Friday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line extends to Trisob Bay Station.
  • December 4 (Sunday): Nawis Railway Snow White Line Parrot Mount Station began operations.
  • December 5 (Monday): Nawis Railway Snow White Line Gabriel Station began operations.
  • December 7 (Wednesday):
    • Nawis Railway Snow White Line Manette Station began operations.
    • Nawis Railway Snow White Line Smelting Bay Station began operations.
  • December 9 (Friday):
    • Nawis Railway Snow White Line Kum Kei Wan Station began operations.
    • Nawis Railway Snow White Line extends to Potato Farmland Station. Snow White Line completed construction.
  • December 12 (Monday): Nazca Railway Stadow Line, Pegasus Line Black Tea Lake Station began operations.
  • December 29 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Zephyr Line Speechless Station began operations.

2023 is the ninth year since Los Sengas was created.

Unless otherwise specified, all events that are described below took place in Los Sengas.

《2021 2022 2023 2024 2025》

Contents

  • 1 List of Historical Events
    • 1.1 January
    • 1.2 February
    • 1.3 March

List of Historical Events[]

January[]

  • January 5 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Sparkling Line Enning Station began operations.
  • January 12 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Glinstrouß Line En-Cogn Station began operations.
  • January 17 (Tuesday): The Encyclopedia of Los Sengas (English) Wiki is established.
  • January 23 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Kivotos Station began operations for Glinstrouß Line, but Prospektious Line platforms did not began operations.
  • January 27 (Friday):
    • Nazca Railway Glinstrouß Line extended from Kivotos Station to Arcgo West Island Station.
    • Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line Xylog Cliff Station completed reconstruction.
  • January 30 (Monday):
    • Nawis Railway Southern Corridor extends to Twenty Village Station.
    • Nawis Railway Southern Corridor Java Beach Station began operations.
  • January 31 (Tuesday):
    • Nazca Railway Prospektious Line began operations between Kivotos Station and Havenore Station. Prospektious Line is established.
    • Nawis Railway Southern Corridor extends to Python Delta Station.

February[]

  • February 3 (Friday):
    • Nawis Railway Southern Corridor Trench Island Station began operations.
    • Nawis Railway Southern Corridor North Clearings Station began operations.
  • February 9 (Thursday): Nawis Railway Southern Corridor Eclipse Fields Station began operations.
  • February 12 (Sunday): Nawis Railway Southern Corridor Craneplaz North Station began operations.
  • February 13 (Monday): Nazca Railway Urban Line Ribera Harbor Station began operations.
  • February 15 (Wednesday): Nawis Railway Southern Corridor Quillow Terrace Station began operations.
  • February 20 (Monday): Nazca Railway Intus Aquilo Gateway completed expansion of the Snowty Line and Mike Line section.
  • February 23 (Thursday): Nawis Railway Southern Corridor Le Monde Station began operations.
  • February 28 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Snowty Line Branches' Hallow Station began operations. Snowty Line is established.

March[]

  • March 1 (Wednesday): Nawis Railway Southern Corridor Moonbeam Heights Station began operations.
  • March 8 (Wednesday): Nawis Railway Southern Corridor extends to Summer Point Gateway.
  • March 10 (Friday): Nazca Railway Snowty Line The Colonnade Station began operations.
  • March 11 (Saturday): Nawis Railway Southern Corridor, Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line Charm River Station began operations.
  • March 15 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Snowty Line extended from The Colonnade Station to Quinty Station.
  • March 16 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Mike Line extended from Intus Aquilo Gateway to Quinty Station. Mike Line is established.
  • March 22 (Wednesday): Cities Transit Peckern South-East Coast Line LSWorld-Expo Station and Stone Shoal Station began operations.
  • March 30 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line Memorial Park Station began operations.

April[]

  • April 4 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line extends to Sincerity Cove Station.
  • April 14 (Friday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line extends to Bonyal Bay Station.
  • April 22 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Stadium Line Prosand Station added Exit G connecting Prosand Eastside.
  • April 23 (Sunday):
    • Nazca Railway Phoenix Line Bonyal North Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway Phoenix Line extends to Vayler North Station.
  • April 29 (Saturday): Cities Transit Peckern South-East Coast Line Gull Woods East Station began operations.

May[]

  • May 5 (Friday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line Maysang West Station began operations.
  • May 6 (Saturday):
    • Los Sengas reorganized its districts:
      • Teraleros became District 32 of Los Sengas.
      • Paloros became District 33 of Los Sengas.
      • West Xofa became District 39 of Los Sengas.
      • The entire Airship Island became a part of Peckern.
  • May 9 (Tuesday): The Sava Line Section of The Three Pass Station is standardized.
  • May 14 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line extends to The Three Pass Station.
  • May 19 (Friday): The Sava Line Section of Southend Station is standardized.
  • May 20 (Saturday): Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line began operations between Wooden Abyss Station and Mount Spadrago Station.
  • May 21 (Sunday):
    • Nazca Railway Phoenix Line extends to Southend Station.
    • Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line began operations between Mount Spadrago Station and Charm River Station.

June[]

  • June 2 (Friday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line Evergarden Station began operations.
  • June 5 (Monday): Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Rapid extends to Charm River Station.
  • June 13 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Sava Line Lotusville Station began operations.
  • June 17 (Saturday): Cities Transit Peckern South-East Coast Line Peckern Bay Station began operations.
  • June 18 (Sunday):
    • Royal Railway Eastern Line Snowing Flatland Station and Inlight River Station began operations. Eastern Line completed construction.
    • Cities Transit Peckern South-East Coast Line Route 5 Station, East Peckern Coast Station and Peckoland Station began operations.
  • June 19 (Monday):
    • Cities Transit Peckern South-East Coast Line Peckern South Beach Resort Station began operations.
    • MetKing Line resumed operations under Creeper Railway.
    • Southern Corridor Express extends to Rapid Rivulet Station.
  • June 20 (Tuesday): Cities Transit Peckern South-East Coast Line Blu Trove Bay Station and Tsing O Station began operations.
  • June 26 (Monday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line extends to West Shoal Checkpoint.
  • June 27 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Sava Line extends to West Shoal Checkpoint.

July[]

  • July 5 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line Odyssey Vista Station began operations.
  • July 12 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line Helios Station began operations.
  • July 17 (Monday):
    • Nazca Railway Xofa Line Ontario Sound Station began operations.
    • Los Sengas Division Season 3 Development complete.

August[]

  • August 1 (Tuesday): Project Nazca eleventh anniversary.
  • August 3 (Thursday): Kioku Island completed reclamation works.
  • August 5 (Saturday):
    • Kioku Island completed road pavement.
    • The road link between Centopia Island and Kioku Island completed construction.
  • August 29 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Utopia Line Kioku Station began operations.

September[]

  • September 5 (Tuesday): Construction of North Parking Lot 1 completed on Centopia Island.
  • September 15 (Friday): Nazca Railway Utopia Line extends to Airship Island Station. Utopia Line completed construction.
  • September 18 (Monday): The road link between Kioku Island and Airship Island completed construction.
  • September 21 (Thursday):
    • Peckern Metro was renamed Peckern Transit.
    • Pelos Metrolink was renamed Metro Line.
  • September 29 (Friday):
    • StarTop Railway Cadence Line Brocades Patio Station completed construction. Cadence Line Phase IV complete.
    • Phantasia Metro Neko Line began operations between Twin Cliffs Station and Abunest Station.

October[]

  • October 8 (Sunday): Sub-contracts for The Flea Market, the North and South Parks, the South Parking Lot and the Hotel on Centopia Island have been open to other developers on the Official Discord Server.
  • October 10 (Tuesday): Construction of North Parking Lot 2 completed on Centopia Island.
  • October 14 (Saturday): Orama Island completed reclamation works.
  • October 21 (Saturday): Construction of The Flea Market completed on Centopia Island.
  • October 27 (Friday): Hakeem Island completed reclamation works.

November[]

  • November 3 (Friday): The road link between Centopia Island and Hakeem Island completed construction.
  • November 5 (Sunday): Orama Island completed road pavement.
  • November 19 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Sparkling Line Hakeem Station began operations.

December[]

  • December 4 (Monday): Leben Island completed reclamation works.
  • December 18 (Monday): Nazca Railway Zephyr Line Leben Station began operations.
  • December 23 (Saturday): Relish Island completed reclamation works.

2024 is the tenth year since Los Sengas was created.

Unless otherwise specified, all events that are described below took place in Los Sengas.

《2022 2023 2024 2025 2026》

Contents

    • 1.1 January

List of Historical Events[]

January[]

  • January 7 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Sparkling Line Relish North Station and Zephyr Line Relish South Station began operations. Sparkling Line and Zephyr Line are connected between Centopia and Apperit Station and between Centopia and Scarlet Spring Station respectively.
  • January 27 (Saturday): Element Hub Transit Evillow Line began operations between Bottom Woods Station and Queens Waterside Station. Evillow Line is established.
  • January 28 (Sunday):
    • Element Hub Transit Evillow Line began operations between Basin Versant Station and Bay Havhest Station.
    • All Roads on Leben Island have been named.
  • January 30 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Sava Line Savanna Central Station is standardized.

February[]

  • February 1 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Sava Line Sand-O Bay Station is standardized.
  • February 4 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Sava Line Venus Street Station is standardized.
  • February 7 (Wednesday):
    • Nazca Railway Sava Line Brackox Station is standardized.
    • Element Hub Transit Evillow Line Solar Sight Station began operations.
    • PTT. Railway Greenwood Line Cord Quad Station began operations.
  • February 8 (Thursday):
    • Element Hub Transit Evillow Line began operations between Angelica Moss Station and Oblique Spit Station.
    • Passageway between Nawis Railway Polywood Station and Cities Transit Polywood Station demolished.
  • February 9 (Friday): Element Hub Transit Evillow Line Rice Lake Station began operations.
  • February 10 (Saturday): Element Hub Transit Evillow Line Afflushore Station began operations.
  • February 12 (Monday): Element Hub Transit Evillow Express began operations between Divights Station and Bay Havhest Station. Evillow Express is established.
  • February 15 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Sava Line Lake Lane Station is standardized.
  • February 18 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Sava Line Hillum Station is standardized.
  • February 19 (Monday):
    • The Sava Line Section of North Mountain Station is standardized.
    • Nazca Railway Sava Line is completely standardized.
  • February 23 (Friday): Element Hub Transit Hook Sand Line Mangkhut Station completed reconstruction.
  • February 25 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Luxter Line Bluewhale Island Station began operations.
  • February 29 (Thursday): Metro Express Transport West Metropolis Line completed construction.

March[]

  • March 4 (Monday): Nazca Railway Luxter Line Fin Bay Station began operations.
  • March 12 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Luxter Line Twintip Rivers Station began operations.
  • March 19 (Tuesday): PTT. Railway Greenwood Line Cameilla Swamp Station began operations.
  • March 22 (Friday): Nazca Railway Luxter Line Mangkhut Sound Station began operations.

April[]

  • April 5 (Friday): Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Line Dansein Joint Stop completed construction.
  • April 7 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Line Mong Ngok Stop completed construction.
  • April 10 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Line South Hare Reflects Stop completed construction, and Tin Kam Line began operations between Dansein Joint and this stop. Tin Kam Line is established.
  • April 15 (Monday): Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Line Wineport Stop completed construction.
  • April 17 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Line Vapourstream Stop completed construction.
  • April 20 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Line Dansein Market Stop completed construction.
  • April 21 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Line began operations between Wineport and Dansein Market.
  • April 27 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Line Po Tin Street Stop completed construction.

May[]

  • May 2 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Line Tai Hing (North) Stop completed construction.
  • May 4 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Line Tai Hing (South) Stop completed construction.
  • May 5 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Line began operations between Po Tin Street and Tai Hing (South).
  • May 10 (Friday): Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Line Tin Shek Park Stop completed construction.
  • May 14 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Line Maple Stop completed construction.
  • May 16 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Line Town Centre (Tong King) Stop completed construction.
  • May 17 (Friday): Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Line began operations between Tin Shek Park and Town Centre (Tong King).
  • May 24 (Friday): Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Line Wai Kam Stop completed construction.
  • May 29 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Line Tin Kam Stop completed construction.
  • May 31 (Friday): Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Line Siu Kam Stop completed construction.

June[]

  • June 4 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Line began operations between Wai Kam and Siu Kam.
  • June 27 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Line Lei Hong Stop, Tin Kam East Court Stop and Tin Kam Court Stop completed construction.
  • June 28 (Friday): Nazca Railway Peckern North LRT Tin Kam Line began operations between Lei Hong and Tin Kam Court, Tin Kam Line completed construction.

July[]

  • July 26 (Friday): Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division Season 4 Development commences.

August[]

  • August 1 (Thursday):
    • Project Nazca twelfth anniversary.
    • Element Hub Transit Evillow Line, Evillow Express Arrowhead Station began operations.
  • August 2 (Friday): Element Hub Transit Evillow Line began operations between Scatter Cave Station and Hillly Strings Station.
  • August 3 (Saturday):
    • Element Hub Transit Evillow Express extends to Hillly Strings Station.
    • Element Hub Transit Evillow Line began operations between Lowwwind Station and Closouth Heights Station.
  • August 9 (Friday): The Lima Line platforms of Old Brightland Checkpoint completed construction. However, as Kaling Channel Station was not yet expanded, Lima Line was not yet established.[1]
  • August 14 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Lima Line extended from Old Brightland Checkpoint to Kaling Channel Station. Lima Line is established.
  • August 23 (Friday):
    • Nazca Railway Lima Line extends to Metropolis Terminal.
    • Nazca Railway Vector Bay Depot completed expansion.

September[]

  • September 4 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Skyward Line, Lima Line Mayler Airport 1 Station began operations.
  • September 10 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Lima Line extends to Sava Coast Station.
  • September 21 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Skyward Line is established.

October[]

  • October 20 (Sunday):
    • Nazca Railway Skyward Line, Swift Line Mayler Airport 2 Station began operations.
    • Grensis Light Rail Transit Flowerplains Line began operations between Allium Lane Station and Moss Bay Station.
  • October 30 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Golf Line, Lima Line Fishpond Vale Station began operations.
  • October 31 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Golf Line extends to Fishpond Vale Station.

November[]

  • November 3 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Golf Line extends to Helios Station.
  • November 7 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line Mistcombe Station began operations.
  • November 13 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line Misty Mount Station began operations.
  • November 22 (Friday): Nazca Railway Stadow Line, Phoenix Line, Golf Line Skyhorse Station began operations.
  • November 25 (Monday): Kapa Channel Island completed reclamation works.
  • November 27 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line Kapa Channel Station began operations.

December[]

  • December 1 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line Poon Tong Station began operations.
  • December 3 (Tuesday): Borealis became District 38 of Los Sengas.
  • December 7 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line Skylark Station began operations.
  • December 11 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Phoenix Line, Golf Line extends to Fall Point Gateway.
  • December 21 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Qoser Coast Station completed expansion of the Rover Line section.
  • December 23 (Monday): Grensis Light Rail Transit Flowerplains Line Azure Tip Station began operations.
  • December 25 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Upper Rover Station completed expansion of the Rover Line section.
  • December 31 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Flask Line extends to Gunshot Island Station.

Citations and References[]

  1. ↑ While the structure of the Lima Line Platforms were set up during the Pegasus Line expansion, the Lima Line Platforms did not complete construction until 2024.

2025 is the eleventh year since Los Sengas was created.

Unless otherwise specified, all events that are described below took place in Los Sengas.

《2023 2024 2025 2026 2027》

Contents

  • 1 List of Historical Events
    • 1.1 January
    • 1.2 February
    • 1.3 March
    • 1.4 April

List of Historical Events[]

January[]

  • January 7 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Rover Line Rover Stadium Station began operations. Rover Line is established.
  • January 13 (Monday): Nazca Railway Rover Line Rotin Station began operations. Rover Line is connected between Qoser Coast Station and Upper Rover Station.
  • January 21 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Rover Line Cheska Hill Station began operations.
  • January 26 (Sunday): Route 3 extends to Coopol Ingress Cape.
  • January 27 (Monday): Nazca Railway Rover Line Keystone Station began operations.

February[]

  • February 4 (Tuesday): Phantasia Metro OasisPaw Line East-greet Bay Station completed reconstruction.
  • February 6 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Flask Line Egret Docks Station began operations.
  • February 9 (Sunday):
    • Peyo became District 43 of Los Sengas.
    • Union became District 44 of Los Sengas.
    • Duotwirl became District 45 of Los Sengas.
  • February 14 (Friday):
    • Element Hub Transit Evillow Line Trench Island Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway Flask Line Sirius Station began operations.
  • February 16 (Sunday): Haruna City Railway Reiher Line began operations between Chun Po Community Station and Shark-A Cove Station.
  • February 22 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Odyssey Circular Anderson Station began operations. Odyssey Circular is established.
  • February 28 (Friday): Nazca Railway Odyssey Circular Oldcastle Station began operations.

March[]

  • March 1 (Saturday): Element Hub Transit Evillow Line, Evillow Express Walnut Tree Station began operations.
  • March 3 (Tuesday): Element Hub Transit Evillow Line, Evillow Express Tai Wan Peninsula Station began operations.
  • March 5 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Odyssey Circular extends to Dragonire Bay Station.
  • March 17 (Monday): Nazca Railway Odyssey Circular Hotwellsham Station began operations.
  • March 18 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Odyssey Circular, Lima Line extends to Sirius Station.
  • March 26 (Wednesday):
    • Nazca Railway Odyssey Circular Gwynfield Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway Odyssey Circular extends to Keystone Station.
  • March 27 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Lima Line extends to Keystone Station.

April[]

  • April 22 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Aquilo Circuit Clearwave Station began operations. Aquilo Circuit is established.
  • April 30 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Aquilo Circuit Greenbay Crest Station began operations.

May[]

  • May 16 (Friday):
    • Nazca Railway Aquilo Circuit Clovefront Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway Aquilo Circuit extends to Branches' Hallow Station.
  • May 22 (Thursday): Grensis Light Rail Transit Flowerplains Line, Grassforest Line Grensis Commercial Area Station began operations. Grassforest Line is established, and Flowerplains Line completed construction.
  • May 26 (Monday):
    • Nazca Railway Pegasus Line Rover Central Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway Pegasus Line extends to Rover Stadium Station.

June[]

  • June 2 (Monday): Grensis Light Rail Transit Grassforest Line Palm Lake Station began operations.
  • June 3 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line Starykanal Station began operations.
  • June 5 (Thursday): Grensis Light Rail Transit Grassforest Line Sandcave Station began operations. Grassforest Line completed construction.
  • June 13 (Friday):
    • Nazca Railway Pegasus Line Oakstone Heights Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway Pegasus Line extends to Clovefront Station.
  • June 14 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Pegasus Line extends to The Colonnade Station.

July[]

  • July 1 (Tuesday): Paleblue Railway Ascentcloud Line began operations between Neon Top Station and Chosen Surge Station.
  • July 7 (Monday): Nazca Railway Coopol Line Sandgap Station began operations. Coopol Line is established.
  • July 14 (Monday):
    • Paleblue Railway Ascentcloud Line Manking Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway Coopol Line extends to Far River Station.
  • July 21 (Monday): Nazca Railway Coopol Line Melocho River Station began operations.
  • July 28 (Monday): Nazca Railway Coopol Line Tooth Cliff Station began operations.

August[]

  • August 1 (Friday): Project Nazca thirteenth anniversary.
  • August 3 (Sunday): Nawis Railway Masquerade Line Inception Bay North Station began operations. Masquerade Line is established.
  • August 5 (Monday): Nawis Railway Masquerade Line Inception Bay Pier Station began operations.
  • August 6 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Coopol Line Warminal Station began operations.
  • August 11 (Monday):
    • Nazca Railway Coopol Line extends to Ingress South Station.
    • Nawis Railway Masquerade Line Kaifong Stadium Station began operations.
  • August 18 (Monday): Nazca Railway released its first soundtrack called "Gleams Between the Rails".
  • August 19 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Coopol Line Skycold Rivulet Station began operations.
  • August 25 (Monday): Nazca Railway Coopol Line extends to Peaceful Steps Station.
  • August 26 (Tuesday): Paleblue Railway Ascentcloud Line Church Creek Station began operations.
  • August 31 (Sunday):
    • Nazca Railway Coopol Line extends to Saber Tower Station.
    • Paleblue Railway Ascentcloud Line Mount Delrow Station began operations.

September[]

  • September 7 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Ingress Line Shardcone Station began operations.
  • September 14 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Ingress Line Silvane Station began operations.
  • September 21 (Sunday):
    • Nazca Railway Ingress Line Lake Winter Station began operations.
    • Paleblue Railway Ascentcloud Line Forest Tip Station began operations.
  • September 30 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Ingress Line, Charlie Line Winter Point Gateway began operations.

October[]

  • October 5 (Sunday): Nawis Railway Masquerade Line Halozy Station began operations.
  • October 6 (Monday): Paleblue Railway Ascentcloud Line Constell Ponds Station began operations.
  • October 13 (Monday):
    • Nazca Railway Rover Line Fairlight Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway released its second soundtrack called "Beneath Lanterns of Frozen Twilight".
  • October 19 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Rover Line Meadowslumber Station began operations.
  • October 22 (Wednesday): Paleblue Railway Ascentcloud Line, Ascentcloud Express Hongwood Station began operations. Ascentcloud Express is established.
  • October 25 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Rover Line Waxing Plains Station began operations.
  • October 31 (Friday): Paleblue Railway Ascentcloud Line Cerulean Sea Station began operations.

November[]

  • November 1 (Saturday): Nazca Railway released its third soundtrack called "Of Soil and Splendor, Of Jest and Joy".
  • November 6 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Rover Line Amongus Lake Station began operations.
  • November 12 (Wednesday):
    • Nazca Railway Rover Line Little Ramp Station began operations.
    • Nazca Railway Rover Line extends to Winter Point Gateway.
  • November 22 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Snowty Line Chenting Station began operations.
  • November 23 (Sunday): Nazca Railway released its fourth soundtrack called "Voices Under the Burden.
  • November 28 (Friday): Nazca Railway Snowty Line Gledecle Station began operations.

December[]

  • December 22 (Monday): Nazca Railway Snowty Line Thousand Flakes Station began operations.
  • December 28 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Snowty Line, Mike Line Magma Line Station began operations.

  • April 4 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Rover Line Corundum Fields Station began operations.

  • May 2 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Starshore Line Angelica Moss Station began operations.
  • May 7 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Starshore Line Firstflare Station began operations.
  • May 8 (Friday): Nazca Railway Starshore Line extends to Spring Point Gateway.
  • May 28 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Daybreaker Line Mansgrove Station began operations.

June[]

  • June 2 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Daybreaker Line extends to Blue Swamp Station.
  • June 10 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Daybreaker Line New Glade Station began operations.
  • June 15 (Monday): Nazca Railway Daybreaker Line extends to Visitor's Ground Station.
  • June 21 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Daybreaker Line Robertson Station began operations.
  • June 27 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Daybreaker Line Sampin Villages Station began operations.
  • June 30 (Tuesday):
    • Nazca Railway Oasis Bay Line, Daybreaker Line Mount Qin West Station began operations. However, as Oasis Bay Line have yet to construct the stations reaching Mount Qin West Station, Oasis Bay Line did not extend to Mount Qin West Station.
    • Nazca Railway Daybreaker Line extends to Spring Point Gateway. Daybreaker Line completed construction.

July[]

  • July 8 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Oasis Bay Line Kingsborough Station began operations.
  • July 13 (Monday): Nazca Railway Oasis Bay Line Queens Station began operations.
  • July 20 (Monday): Nawis Railway Masquerade Line Regent Park Station began operations.
  • July 21 (Tuesday): Nazca Railway Oasis Bay Line Parrot Mount Station began operations.
  • July 29 (Wednesday): Nazca Railway Oasis Bay Line Pinewatch Station began operations.
  • July 30 (Thursday): Nazca Railway Oasis Bay Line extends to Spring Point Gateway.

August[]

  • August 1 (Saturday):
    • Project Nazca fourteenth anniversary.
    • Phantasia Metro Fuurin Line began operations between Lens Station and Barren Valley Station.
    • Phantasia Metro Fuurin Express began operations between Lens Station and High Parallel Station.
  • August 8 (Saturday): Nazca Railway Oasis Bay Line Commons Creek Station began operations.
  • August 16 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Oasis Bay Line Graydome Station began operations.

  • August 30 (Sunday): Nazca Railway Oasis Bay Line Lake Yore Station began operations.

Abunest East Station is a station on East Ring Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Torrent.

Fun Facts[]

  • Due to the Exit Distribution of this Station, both the Los Sengas Coffee and Lavatories are set outside the Gate Area of this station.
  • This Station, along with Abunest West Station, are stations that are related to densely grown forests, and the green color is preferred for both stations.[2] As a result, Lime Wool is used in this station due to the belief that the East usually has brighter sunlight than the west.[3]
  • Plantation is seen above the ceiling of this station.
  • The Extension of East Ring Line to this station has caused Nazca Railway to have an operational length of over 500 km in a single direction.[4]
  • In terms of Stations on the Main Branch, this station is the furthest and on the opposite side from Metropolis Terminal.

Future Development[]

  • This Station is one of the two future candidate interchanges with Luxter Line, with the other candidate being Abunest West Station.

History[]

  • September 26 2017: This station began services.

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station, along with Abunest East Station, are stations that are related to densely grown forests, and the green color is preferred for both stations.[2] As a result, Green Wool is used in this station due to the fact that Lime Wool is already used at Abunest East Station.
  • The Station Control Room of this station is not located at the main station structure. Instead, it is located on an island to the north of the station.
  • Despite being built in the middle of the sea in a fashion similar to Johnson Views Station, as support pillars exist beneath this station, this station is an Elevated Station instead of a Floating Station.
  • The Station is built in the middle of the sea, but only at the Photic Zone. Support pillars are planted onto the seabed in a fashion similar to the Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge.
  • The shape of this station is olive-shaped. This alludes to the platforms of Comet Terrace Station and increases the convenience of setting up of stairs.[3]

Future Development[]

  • This Station is one of the two future candidate interchanges with Luxter Line, with the other candidate being Abunest East Station.

History[]

  • September 27 2017: This Station began operations.
  • October 4 2017: This station was chosen by Nazca Railway as the location of the background image during the Mid-Autumn Festival.[4]

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Of Soil and Splendor, Of Jest and Joy".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
Foundation Nexus 01:21
Pillars of Continuity 01:52

Fun Facts[]

  • This Station features the second set of Connecting Stations between Nazca Railway Stations with Southeast Island Station, with the first set being White Margin Station and East Margin Station.
  • To allude to the name of this station and give it a good foundation, blue is used as the color scheme of this station.[2]
  • Among the West Metropolis Archipelago islands, this island has the most well-developed underground area. As a result, the concourse of this station is built at the south of Abutment Island, where the island is less developed underground. Moreover, the U-shaped concourse of this station corresponds to the shape of this island.[3][4]

History[]

  • November 11 2018: This Station completed construction, but as Stadow Line is not yet connected to another station, the Platforms of this station remain reserved.
  • November 19 2018: Stadow Line is established.
  • August 27 2020: This station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[5]
  • March 27 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • January 9 2025: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[6]

Abyss Line is Line Number 18 of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. This line has 12 stations and was established on April 3 2018. It runs between Shore Tip and Heart River.

Description []

Abyss Line is one of the Auxiliary lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It runs along Internal Sea, Yowah, Punctual and Oasis.

This route is represented by Turquoise Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 18.

Currently, this route is 17.645 km long, with a total of 12 stations.

History[]

  • S2E18: Kong Corner - Heart River
  • S3E7: Shore Tip - Heart River

Nazca Railway Development Plan 2024 Edition[]

Direction Development Details Progress
Up Extend Southwards from Heart River Station and interchange with Oasis Bay Line TBC

Districts Served[]

  • Internal Sea
  • Yowah
  • Punctual
  • Oasis

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the Auxiliary Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division.
  • One of the permanent termini lays in Internal Sea. (Shore Tip)

Fun Facts[]

  • The section of Abyss Line tracks between Heart River Station and to the south of Justin Station lay on a canal that is temporarilly named "Liver River".
  • A six-lane dual carriageway lays between the same section as Liver River that is named after this line on both sides of Liver River.
  • This line will extend to Oasis Bay Line Kingsborough Station in the future.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station shares structure, exit numbers and platform numbers with StarTop Railway Aest Station.
  • This station used to have the shortest English name at only four letters, until it is replaced by Io Station.
  • Originally, this station planned to use the green color as the main color. However, it changed to the current style as the flag of France to commemorate the November 2015 Paris Attacks.
  • This station should be pronounced as "a-east", but former Streamer Kata Ho pronounced it as "S" in the station introduction of Season 1 Episode 17[2].

History[]

  • November 18 2015: This station began services.
  • September 22 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[3]
  • December 14 2016: This station completed repair works of Platform 1.[4]
  • September 11 2020: Exits C and D are added to this station to connect to the StarTop Railway Station of the Same Name.[5]
  • May 3 2024: The Station Banners of this station are set up.
  • August 3 2026: This station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[6]

Afflushore Station is a station on Cometsilk Line. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Prymea. Passengers may also use this station to change to Element Hub Transit Evillow Line (Afflushore Station) and SLT Line 2611 (Afflushore Coastside Stop).

Fun Facts[]

  • At the time of the Construction of this Station, it was located at Starshore. However, following the establishment of Prymea as District Number 26 on May 4, Starshore was merged by Prymea and no longer exists.
  • Due to the high height difference between Arrowhead Station and this station, an artificial island resembling the one at the Chinese Side of Hong Kong-Zhuhai-Macau Bridge is built to the east of this station.[2]
  • The design of this station corresponds to Recuérdame Station of Wanderer Line due to their similar sizes and their small designed passenger numbers.[3]

History[]

  • January 16 2022: This station completed construction.[4]
  • January 17 2022: This station began services.
  • May 8 2024: Exit C is added to this station to connect to the Element Hub Transit Station of the Same Name.

title: Airship Island
safeHtml:
Airship Island is the largest natural island in Los Sengas. At the time of its existence, its District Number was 21. It is located to the southwest of Peckern, the northwest of Twenty-Second Continent, the southwest of West Metropolis Archipelago and the northeast of Centopia. On May 4 2022 this island was split into Peckern and Twenty-Second Districts, but the entire island became a part of Peckern on May 6 2023.

Contents

  • 1 Location
  • 2 Transport
    • 2.1 Nazca Railway
    • 2.2 Routes
    • 2.3 Roads
  • 3 Facilities
  • 4 Nearby Districts
  • 5 Citations and References

Location[]

Airship Island is located to the southwest of Peckern Continent and the northwest of Twenty-Second Continent. While this island is the largest natural island in Los Sengas, it does not belong to West Metropolis Archipelago.

Transport[]

Nazca Railway[]

  • West Ring Line, Utopia Line Airship Island Station
  • West Ring Line Airship Deck Station

Routes[]

Roads[]

Facilities[]

Currently, Airship Island is home to a bus terminus, a street terminal and other basic road connections. Moreover, this island is also one of the candidates for the location of Los Sengas University. However, despite being the confirmed location of the university, the university is still under construction as of yet. Moreover, roads connecting to Kioku Island of Centopia were built on September 18 2023.

Nearby Districts[]

  • West Metropolis Archipelago (To the Northeast)
  • Peckern (To the Northwest)
  • Twenty-Second Continent (To the Southeast)
  • Centopia (To the Southwest)

Fun Facts[]

  • A memorial that highlights all the stations along West Ring Line and Utopia Line starting from this station, is hung from the ceiling of this station to the east side of the concourse. However, the Utopia Line part of the memorial wasn't built until the Utopia Line expansion.
  • Some of the station facilities, such as the Station Control Room and the lavatories, are located at the West Ring Line Platform level instead of the concourse level.

Future Development[]

  • The exits of this station will be reorganized to complement the construction of Los Sengas University.

History[]

  • September 24 2015: This station began services alongside West Ring Line.
  • August 16 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[2]
  • September 11 2023: This station began expansion of the Utopia Line Part.
  • September 14 2023: This station completed expansion.
  • September 15 2023: Utopia Line extends from Kioku Station to this station. Utopia Line completed development.
  • September 20 2023: The Station Banners of this station are set up.

Description[]

Akashi Line is one of the District Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It passes through TriPaw, Jupiter and Twenty-Second Continent.

This line is represented by Fuchsia on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number 30.

Currently, this route is 28.1 km long, with a total of 21 stations.

Development Plans and History[]

Development Plans[]

  • Since November 2019, TriPaw and Twenty-Second Continent have seen drastic development and rapid surges in population. As of June 2020, population in Twenty-Second has reached 310 thousand, with 180 thousand of them having no access to rail transport and has to rely entirely on road transport. This causes severe traffic problems in the Twenty-Second Continent.
  • To alleviate Traffic congestions, the developer of Twenty-Second Continent and TriPaw has submitted a proposal to Nazca and suggested a new Standard Railway line on Nazca Railway that starts from Firewood Point station, and passes through Old Brightland, Mount Galileo and Downdike Bay, before proceeding to Diamond Pool, Halozy and Craneplaz in Twenty-Second Continent and ending in Le Monde.
  • While this proposal was initially accepted by Nazca Railway, if the line starting from Firewood Point has to pass through Old Brightland, the line would have to make an extremely large detour just in TriPaw alone before reaching Downdike Bay. As a result, the terminus of this line has been moved to Old Brightland, and the section between Firewood Point and Old Brightland was replaced by Daybreaker Line to alleviate transport needs in that area.
  • It should also be noticed that, in the final stages of the plan, the section going through Mount Galileo was cancelled and was instead given to Pegasus Line. Passengers can go to Galileo Heights from Old Brightland using Pegasus Line.

Development Chapters[]

  • S3E12: Old Brightland - Freedom Bay
  • S3E13P2: Old Brightland - Python Delta
  • S3E14P2: Old Brightland - Summer Point (Line Complete)

Districts Served[]

  • TriPaw
  • Jupiter
  • Twenty-Second Continent

Line Characteristics[]

  • One of the District Lines of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. This line mainly serves TriPaw, Jupiter and Twenty-Second Continent to facilitate their urban development.
  • Both Daybreaker Line and Vision Line serve as auxiliary lines for this line.
  • Express Services of this line：
    • Urban Line: Seraphynx to Mei Fwong
    • Bravo Line: Darey Terrace to Le Monde

Fun Facts[]

  • While Old Brightland Checkpoint (Then Old Brightland Station) was already confirmed to be the permanent downward Terminus of this line, the turn back sidings for this line at the Old Brightland side was not constructed until the Daybreaker Line extension to Oasis on May 2022.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is the second of a series of three stations that are built to commemorate Samuel, the owner of Inter-Galactic Media Group, photobombing into the Second Ride Video of S2E4, with the other two stations being Spring Lakeny Station and Lei Tiu Lau Station.
  • According to the Railway Builder, the Chinese Name of this station alludes to Photobombing, and this name is used simply due to the fact that Samuel photobomed.
  • Photobombing refers to an action in which a person deliberately puts oneself onto a photograph in order to play a practical joke on the photographer or the subjects.
  • This Station adopts castle-themed designs in this station regarding the chairs at the platforms, the rectangular concourse shape and the gray concrete.
  • A sidings track is put between Platforms 1 and 2 of this station. As a wall is present behind both platforms, this layout is similar to that of Everbond Station.

History[]

  • August 26 2022: This station began services.
  • December 24 2023: The Station Title Banner of this station is added.
  • August 12 2024: This Station completed its Station Title and Icon Upgrade Scheme.[2]

Alpha Line is a Veloduct of NR Los Sengas Division. With 6 stations along the line, this line was established on May 3 2016, and runs between Centopia and Sand Martin.

Description []

Alpha Line is one of the Veloducts of Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. The line starts from Centopia, and skirts the north-western edge of Twenty-Second Continent before passing through West Metropolis Archipelago and stopping in Downtown. Afterwards, it passes through north Katadelphia and Zootuary before arriving in Internal Sea.

This line is represented by Milky Red Color on the Nazca Railway Route Map, and is Line Number A.

Currently, this line is 32.855 km long, with a total of 6 stations.

History[]

  • S2E3: Metropolis-Zootuary
  • S2E6: Comp Ward-Zootuary
  • S3E7: Comp Ward-Sand Martin
  • S3E12: Centopia-Sand Martin

Nazca Railway 2021 Development Outline[]

Direction Development Details Progress

Districts Served[]

  • Centopia

    • Bonyal (Passes Through)

  • Zootuary

Line Characteristics[]

  • This line is the second Veloduct to begin operations and the first existing Veloduct to be built in Nazca Railway Los Sengas Division. It is also the first Veloduct to complete construction.
  • The section near Zootuary integrates with the ecological properties of the vicinities, and due to the fact that it passes through Zootuary, the speed of the train is also slowed down to reduce noise pollution. As a result, this Veloduct has the lowest operational speed near Zootuary, at just 30 km/h.
  • The section between Comp Ward and Metropolis used to have the longest inter-station distance in Los Sengas Division at 12.43 km. However, in S3E2, this record is broken by Urban Express when the section between Metropolis and Tat Stone Hill began operations at 13.02 km. However, this section still holds the longest inter-station distance for Veloducts.
  • Parts of this line shares tracks with New Edward Line and Bravo Line.
  • This line is the only Veloduct that has a permanent terminus at (Zootuary).
  • Among the lines stopping at Metropolis Terminal, this line is the only line that does not use it as the "Zero Station".
  • Centopia is constructed in an artificial island.
  • The train arrival announcements of this line allude to East Rail Line of Mass Transit Railway.
  • This line provides Express Services for the following lines:
    • West Ring Line: Metropolis to Comp Ward. [1]
    • New Edward Line (West): Metropolis to Comp Ward. [2]
    • Arcgo Line (East): Metropolis to Katadelphia North.

Fun Facts[]

  • This line is the first line to be established in Season 2 that is still currently in operation.[3]

Station Title and Soundtrack[]

  • The Station Title of this Station is This is Sus.
  • This Station features two soundtracks that belong to the album "Where Cold Order Moves and Night Becomes String".
Name of the Soundtrack Length (mm:ss)
This is Sus 01:48

Fun Facts[]

  • The name of this Station is taken from the 2018 Multiplayer Video Game Among Us, developed by American Game Studio Innersloth. This is due to the fact that the two lakes nearby this station takes an appearance similar to that of Characters in that game.
  • The Station Icon of this Station makes use of elements from Among Us. The Foreground of the Station Icon is a miniature version of The Skeld, with the background being the Old Design of the Emergency Meeting Screen.
  • A one-to-one Replica of The Skeld is built between the Ground Level and the Concourse of this Station, complete with Vents that enable players to travel to respective locations. However, notably, the Vents in this Station are Squares instead of Round-cornered in Among Us.
  • The Tables and Chairs in the Los Sengas Coffee of this Station are replaced by Meeting Tables and Chairs in a style simiar to that of the Cafeteria in The Skeld.
  • The Benches at the Platforms of this Station resemble Beds in the MedBay of The Skeld.
  • The Elevator that provides access to The Skeld at the Concourse of this Station leads to the Cafeteria. This corresponds to the fact that the Cafeteria is the Spawn Point of The Skeld.[3]
  • Due to Minecraft constraints, Cameras are not present in the the walls on the sides of passageways in The Skeld.

History[]

  • October 30 2025: This Station began construction.
  • November 4 2025: This Station completed construction.
  • November 6 2025: This station began services.

Anderson Station is a station on Odyssey Circular. It is operated by Nazca Railway (Los Sengas Division), and is located at Los Sengas Odyssey. Passengers may also use this station to change to SLT Line 3512, Line 3515, Line 3516 (Hei Yee Stop).

Fun Facts[]

  • The tentative location of Exit B has already been decided to be at the west side of the junction between Hei Shun Road and Hei Yee Road. However, that Exit was not built as a consensus of the exact location could not be reached with Odyssey developers.[3]
  • Exit A1 of this station marks a new Season 4-styled design for Dual-Elevator Exits which are prevalent at West Metropolis Archipelago Nazca Railway Stations.[4]

History[]

  • February 20 2025: This Station began construction.
  • February 21 2025: This Station completed construction.
  • February 22 2025: This Station began services. Odyssey Circular is established.
  • May 19 2025: The Station Icon of this station is added.

Fun Facts[]

  • At the time of the construction of this Station, it did not have a concourse. However, in order to complement the construction of the Nazca Railway Starshore Line Station of the Same Name, the transfer passageways have been demolished to make way for a new Concourse and new Station Facilities. Additionally, Station Decorations featuring trees with wool denoting the colors for Evillow Line and Starshore Line as support are also built.
  • The station number of Evillow Line for this station was EV-10. However, it has later been changed to EV-12 due to Station Number rearrangements.

Fun Facts[]

  • This station is likely built to commemorate the same Edward as the one in Comic Ward Station. In Los Sengas Division, there are four other stations that are built to commemorate different people in Project Nazca who are named Edward and had contributed to this server, namely Comp Ward, Pan-ward, Comic Ward and Edward Island.
  • Exit C of this station shares structure with a naturally-spawned Desert Pyramid, the only such instance in Los Sengas Division. As a result, the exit banners of this station exhibit a sandy yellow color instead of the typical black color.
  • The color scheme of this station alludes to Comic Ward Station.

History[]

  • October 14 2015: This station began services. Kinight Line is established.
  • September 1 2016: This station finished Upgrading Works.[4]
  • July 2 2018: This station finished Second Stage Upgrading Works.[5]
  • August 5 2020: This station completed Second Phase IoM Sign Replacement Works.[6]
  • June 15 2021: Exits B and E of this station are removed, and Exit A2 is added to this station.[7]
  • March 6 2024: The Station Banners of this station are set up.
